'use client'

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react'
import {
  Users,
  Search,
  Wand2,
  CheckCircle2,
  GripVertical,
  UserCheck,
  Loader2,
  Sparkles,
} from 'lucide-react'
import type { StudentWithEnrollment } from '@/lib/types/students'

interface StudentTrayProps {
  unassignedStudents: StudentWithEnrollment[]
  selectedStudent: StudentWithEnrollment | null
  onSelectStudent: (student: StudentWithEnrollment | null) => void
  onAutoAssign: () => void
  isAutoAssigning?: boolean
  isPrivileged?: boolean
  className?: string
}

export function StudentTray({
  unassignedStudents,
  selectedStudent,
  onSelectStudent,
  onAutoAssign,
  isAutoAssigning = false,
  isPrivileged = false,
  className = '',
}: StudentTrayProps) {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('')

  // Filter students by roll number or name
  const filteredStudents = useMemo(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return unassignedStudents
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim()
    return unassignedStudents.filter((s) => {
      const matchRoll = String(s.roll_number).includes(q)
      const matchName = s.full_name.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      const matchAdm = s.admission_no?.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      return matchRoll || matchName || matchAdm
    })
  }, [unassignedStudents, searchQuery])

  return (
    <div
      className={`flex flex-col rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#101726] shadow-xl overflow-hidden ${className}`}
    >
      {/* Header Dock */}
      <div className="p-3.5 border-b border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32]/60">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-2.5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-400">
              <Users className="h-4 w-4" />
            </span>
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-heading font-extrabold text-xs sm:text-sm text-white">
                Unassigned Students
              </h3>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                {unassignedStudents.length} awaiting seat placement
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <span
            className={`font-mono text-xs font-extrabold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${
              unassignedStudents.length > 0
                ? 'bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/30 text-amber-400'
                : 'bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400'
            }`}
          >
            {unassignedStudents.length}
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Search Input */}
        <div className="relative">
          <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-500" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search roll or student name..."
            className="w-full rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#0B0F19] pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-slate-500 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none transition-colors"
          />
          {searchQuery && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
              className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[10px] text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
            >
              Clear
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Student List Bay */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto max-h-[380px] sm:max-h-[440px] p-2 space-y-1.5 divide-y divide-white/[0.04]">
        {unassignedStudents.length === 0 ? (
          // Meaningful Empty State: All students assigned
          <div className="py-8 px-4 text-center">
            <div className="h-10 w-10 mx-auto rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 flex items-center justify-center border border-emerald-500/20 mb-2.5">
              <CheckCircle2 className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-white">Full Cohort Seated</h4>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
              All enrolled students for this class have an assigned workstation.
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : filteredStudents.length === 0 ? (
          // No match for search query
          <div className="py-6 px-4 text-center text-xs text-slate-400">
            No unassigned students match &ldquo;{searchQuery}&rdquo;.
          </div>
        ) : (
          filteredStudents.map((student) => {
            const isSelected = selectedStudent?.enrollment_id === student.enrollment_id

            return (
              <div
                key={student.enrollment_id}
                draggable={isPrivileged}
                onDragStart={
                  isPrivileged
                    ? (e) => {
                        e.dataTransfer.setData(
                          'application/json',
                          JSON.stringify({
                            type: 'student',
                            enrollment_id: student.enrollment_id,
                            student_name: student.full_name,
                            roll_number: student.roll_number,
                          })
                        )
                      }
                    : undefined
                }
                onClick={isPrivileged ? () => onSelectStudent(isSelected ? null : student) : undefined}
                className={`group flex items-center justify-between gap-2 p-2 rounded-xl border transition-all select-none ${
                  isPrivileged ? 'cursor-pointer' : 'cursor-default'
                } ${
                  isSelected
                    ? 'border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-500/10 ring-1 ring-indigo-500/50 shadow-sm'
                    : 'border-white/[0.04] bg-[#151E32]/40 hover:bg-[#151E32] hover:border-white/[0.08]'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                  {isPrivileged && (
                    <div className="text-slate-500 group-hover:text-slate-300 transition-colors">
                      <GripVertical className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <span className="font-mono text-xs font-extrabold text-indigo-400 bg-indigo-500/10 border border-indigo-500/20 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md tabular-nums shrink-0">
                    Roll {student.roll_number}
                  </span>

                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-200 truncate">
                    {student.full_name}
                  </span>
                </div>

                {isPrivileged && (
                  <div className="shrink-0 text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                    {isSelected ? (
                      <span className="font-bold text-indigo-400">Tap PC</span>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-slate-500 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                        Assign
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )
          })
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Action Footer: Auto-Assign Remaining (Privileged Only) */}
      {unassignedStudents.length > 0 && isPrivileged && (
        <div className="p-3 border-t border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32]/80">
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={isAutoAssigning}
            onClick={onAutoAssign}
            className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-md transition-all disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
          >
            {isAutoAssigning ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                <span>Auto-Assigning...</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Wand2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                <span>Auto Assign Remaining ({unassignedStudents.length})</span>
              </>
            )}
          </button>
          <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 text-center mt-1.5 leading-tight">
            Preserves manual seats. Skips decommissioned &amp; critical hardware faults.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {unassignedStudents.length > 0 && !isPrivileged && (
        <div className="p-3 border-t border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32]/40 text-center">
          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
            Read-only session view. Unassigned students are managed by Super Admin or Lab In-Charge.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

import type {
  WorkstationBoardData,
  WorkstationWithIssues,
} from '@/types/workstations'

interface WorkstationBoardProps {
  initialData: WorkstationBoardData
}

export function WorkstationBoard({ initialData }: WorkstationBoardProps) {
  const [boardData, setBoardData] = useState<WorkstationBoardData>(initialData)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const [selectedLabId, setSelectedLabId] = useState<string>(initialData.lab_id || 'comp')

  // Selected workstation for drawer
  const [selectedWorkstation, setSelectedWorkstation] = useState<WorkstationWithIssues | null>(null)
  const [isDrawerOpen, setIsDrawerOpen] = useState(false)

  // Taxonomy Modal (Admin)
  const [isCategoryModalOpen, setIsCategoryModalOpen] = useState(false)

  // View Mode: 'canvas' (2D Floor Plan) vs 'matrix' (Mobile Grid)
  const [mobileCanvasActive, setMobileCanvasActive] = useState(false)

  // Refresh Board Data
  const refreshData = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true)
    try {
      const data = await getWorkstationBoardData(selectedLabId)
      setBoardData(data)

      // If drawer is open, keep selected workstation up to date
      if (selectedWorkstation) {
        const updated = data.workstations.find((w) => w.id === selectedWorkstation.id)
        if (updated) setSelectedWorkstation(updated)
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to refresh workstation telemetry:', err)
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }, [selectedLabId, selectedWorkstation])

  // Workstation Select
  const handleSelectWorkstation = (ws: WorkstationWithIssues) => {
    setSelectedWorkstation(ws)
    setIsDrawerOpen(true)
  }

  // Workstation Select by ID (from Seat Planning modal)
  const handleSelectWorkstationById = (wsId: string) => {
    const ws = boardData.workstations.find((w) => w.id === wsId)
    if (ws) {
      setSelectedWorkstation(ws)
      setIsDrawerOpen(true)
    }

    const supabase = createClient()
    const channel = supabase
      .channel('workstations-realtime-telemetry')
      .on(
        'postgres_changes',
        { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'workstation_issues' },
        () => {
          refreshData()
        }
      )
      .on(
        'postgres_changes',
        { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'workstations' },
        () => {
          refreshData()
        }
      )
      .on(
        'postgres_changes',
        { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'lab_floor_elements' },
        () => {
          refreshData()
        }
      )
      .subscribe()

    return () => {
      supabase.removeChannel(channel)
    }
  }, [refreshData])

  const { metrics, is_privileged, user_id, user_name } = boardData

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Top Header & Telemetry KPI Cards */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-3 border-b border-white/[0.08] pb-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <h2 className="font-heading font-extrabold text-xl text-white tracking-tight">
              Computer Lab Management
            </h2>
            <span className="rounded-full bg-indigo-500/10 border border-indigo-500/30 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-400">
              {boardData.lab_name}

              <Monitor className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              <span>Floor Map</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {is_privileged && (
            <button
              type="button"

              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32] px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-200 hover:border-indigo-500/40 hover:text-indigo-300 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Tag className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              <span>Issue Taxonomy</span>

        <CategoryAdminModal
          categories={boardData.categories}

          onClose={() => setIsCategoryModalOpen(false)}
          onSuccess={refreshData}

'use client'

import React, { useState, useRef, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react'
import {
  Lock,
  Unlock,
  Save,
  Plus,
  RefreshCw,
  Loader2,
  Tv,
  CheckCircle2,
  ShieldAlert,
  Wrench,
  Sparkles,
  Layers,
  MapPin,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { WorkstationNode } from './workstation-node'
import { FloorLandmarkNode } from './floor-landmark-node'
import {
  updateWorkstationPositions,
  createWorkstation,
} from '@/app/actions/workstations'
import {
  saveLabFloorElements,
  deleteLabFloorElement,
} from '@/app/actions/floor-elements'
import type {
  WorkstationWithIssues,
  UpdateWorkstationPositionInput,
} from '@/types/workstations'
import type { IssueCategoryRow, LabFloorElementRow } from '@/types/database'
import { FLOOR_ELEMENT_CATALOG } from '@/lib/floor-elements'
import { LabDeskStructureOverlay } from '@/components/computer-lab/lab-desk-structure-overlay'

interface WorkstationFloorPlanProps {
  workstations: WorkstationWithIssues[]
  categories?: IssueCategoryRow[]
  floorElements?: LabFloorElementRow[]
  labId: string
  labName: string
  isPrivileged: boolean
  isSeatPlanMode?: boolean
  selectedWorkstationId?: string | null
  onSelectWorkstation: (ws: WorkstationWithIssues) => void
  onRefreshData: () => void
}

export function WorkstationFloorPlan({
  workstations,
  categories = [],
  floorElements = [],
  labId,
  labName,
  isPrivileged,
  isSeatPlanMode = false,
  selectedWorkstationId,
  onSelectWorkstation,
  onRefreshData,
}: WorkstationFloorPlanProps) {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [localWorkstations, setLocalWorkstations] = useState<WorkstationWithIssues[]>(workstations)
  const [localFloorElements, setLocalFloorElements] = useState<LabFloorElementRow[]>(floorElements)
  const [isLayoutMode, setIsLayoutMode] = useState(false)
  const [hasUnsavedChanges, setHasUnsavedChanges] = useState(false)
  const [savingPositions, setSavingPositions] = useState(false)
  const [saveMessage, setSaveMessage] = useState<string | null>(null)

  // Dragging state for Workstations
  const draggingIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null)

  // Add Workstation Modal State
  const [isAddModalOpen, setIsAddModalOpen] = useState(false)
  const [newLabel, setNewLabel] = useState('')
  const [newRow, setNewRow] = useState('Row A')
  const [newDeviceType, setNewDeviceType] = useState<'desktop' | 'aio' | 'laptop' | 'server'>('desktop')
  const [addingStation, setAddingStation] = useState(false)

  // Add Landmark Modal State
  const [isAddLandmarkOpen, setIsAddLandmarkOpen] = useState(false)
  const [selectedLandmarkType, setSelectedLandmarkType] = useState('whiteboard')
  const [newLandmarkLabel, setNewLandmarkLabel] = useState('Interactive Whiteboard')

  // Sync when parent workstations or floor elements change (if not currently editing layout)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hasUnsavedChanges) {
      setLocalWorkstations(workstations)
    }
  }, [workstations, hasUnsavedChanges])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hasUnsavedChanges) {
      setLocalFloorElements(floorElements)
    }
  }, [floorElements, hasUnsavedChanges])

  // Workstation Drag Handler
  const handleDragStart = useCallback(
    (e: React.PointerEvent, ws: WorkstationWithIssues) => {
      if (!isLayoutMode || !isPrivileged) return
      e.preventDefault()
      e.stopPropagation()

      draggingIdRef.current = ws.id

      const handlePointerMove = (moveEvent: PointerEvent) => {
        if (!canvasRef.current || !draggingIdRef.current) return

        const rect = canvasRef.current.getBoundingClientRect()
        const rawX = ((moveEvent.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100
        const rawY = ((moveEvent.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100

        // Snap to 2% grid increments and clamp inside walls (4% to 96%)
        const snappedX = Math.round(rawX / 2) * 2
        const snappedY = Math.round(rawY / 2) * 2
        const clampedX = Math.max(4, Math.min(96, snappedX))
        const clampedY = Math.max(6, Math.min(94, snappedY))

        setLocalWorkstations((prev) =>
          prev.map((item) =>
            item.id === draggingIdRef.current
              ? { ...item, pos_x: clampedX, pos_y: clampedY }
              : item
          )
        )
        setHasUnsavedChanges(true)
      }

      const handlePointerUp = () => {
        draggingIdRef.current = null
        window.removeEventListener('pointermove', handlePointerMove)
        window.removeEventListener('pointerup', handlePointerUp)
      }

      window.addEventListener('pointermove', handlePointerMove)
      window.addEventListener('pointerup', handlePointerUp)
    },
    [isLayoutMode, isPrivileged]
  )

  // Landmark Drag Handler
  const handleDragLandmarkStart = useCallback(
    (e: React.PointerEvent, el: LabFloorElementRow) => {
      if (!isLayoutMode || !isPrivileged) return
      e.preventDefault()
      e.stopPropagation()

      const targetId = el.id

      const handlePointerMove = (moveEvent: PointerEvent) => {
        if (!canvasRef.current) return

        const rect = canvasRef.current.getBoundingClientRect()
        const rawX = ((moveEvent.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100
        const rawY = ((moveEvent.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100

        const snappedX = Math.round(rawX / 2) * 2
        const snappedY = Math.round(rawY / 2) * 2
        const clampedX = Math.max(2, Math.min(98, snappedX))
        const clampedY = Math.max(2, Math.min(98, snappedY))

        setLocalFloorElements((prev) =>
          prev.map((item) =>
            item.id === targetId ? { ...item, pos_x: clampedX, pos_y: clampedY } : item
          )
        )
        setHasUnsavedChanges(true)
      }

      const handlePointerUp = () => {
        window.removeEventListener('pointermove', handlePointerMove)
        window.removeEventListener('pointerup', handlePointerUp)
      }

      window.addEventListener('pointermove', handlePointerMove)
      window.addEventListener('pointerup', handlePointerUp)
    },
    [isLayoutMode, isPrivileged]
  )

  // Landmark Rotate Handler (90 deg)
  const handleRotateLandmark = (el: LabFloorElementRow) => {
    setLocalFloorElements((prev) =>
      prev.map((item) =>
        item.id === el.id
          ? { ...item, rotation: (((item.rotation || 0) + 90) % 360) as any }
          : item
      )
    )
    setHasUnsavedChanges(true)
  }

  // Landmark Delete Handler
  const handleDeleteLandmark = (el: LabFloorElementRow) => {
    setLocalFloorElements((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== el.id))
    setHasUnsavedChanges(true)
  }

  // Save Layout Positions (Workstations + Landmarks)
  const handleSavePositions = async () => {
    setSavingPositions(true)
    setSaveMessage(null)

    const wsPayload: UpdateWorkstationPositionInput[] = localWorkstations.map((ws) => ({
      id: ws.id,
      pos_x: ws.pos_x,
      pos_y: ws.pos_y,
    }))

    const landmarkPayload = localFloorElements.map((el) => ({
      id: el.id,
      lab_id: labId,
      element_type: el.element_type,
      label: el.label,
      pos_x: el.pos_x,
      pos_y: el.pos_y,
      width: el.width || 12.0,
      height: el.height || 4.0,
      rotation: (el.rotation || 0) as 0 | 90 | 180 | 270,
      is_active: el.is_active,
    }))

    try {
      const [wsRes, elRes] = await Promise.all([
        updateWorkstationPositions(wsPayload),
        saveLabFloorElements(labId, landmarkPayload),
      ])

      if (!wsRes.success) throw new Error(wsRes.error || 'Failed to save workstation positions.')
      if (!elRes.success) throw new Error(elRes.error || 'Failed to save floor landmarks.')

      setHasUnsavedChanges(false)
      setSaveMessage('Physical room layout saved successfully.')
      setTimeout(() => setSaveMessage(null), 2500)
      onRefreshData()
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Save failed'
      setSaveMessage(`Error: ${msg}`)
    } finally {
      setSavingPositions(false)
    }
  }

  // Reset to Prop Positions
  const handleDiscardChanges = () => {
    setLocalWorkstations(workstations)
    setLocalFloorElements(floorElements)
    setHasUnsavedChanges(false)
    setSaveMessage(null)
  }

  // Create New Workstation
  const handleCreateWorkstation = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!newLabel.trim()) return

    setAddingStation(true)
    try {
      const res = await createWorkstation({
        lab_id: labId,
        label: newLabel.trim(),
        row_label: newRow.trim() || null,
        pos_x: 50.0,
        pos_y: 50.0,
        device_type: newDeviceType,
      })

      if (!res.success) {
        throw new Error(res.error || 'Failed to create workstation.')
      }

      setIsAddModalOpen(false)
      setNewLabel('')
      onRefreshData()
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      alert(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Error adding workstation')
    } finally {
      setAddingStation(false)
    }
  }

  // Add Landmark from Catalog
  const handleAddLandmark = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    const def = FLOOR_ELEMENT_CATALOG[selectedLandmarkType] || {
      defaultWidth: 12.0,
      defaultHeight: 4.0,
    }

    const newElement: LabFloorElementRow = {
      id: `temp-${Date.now()}`,
      lab_id: labId,
      element_type: selectedLandmarkType,
      label: newLandmarkLabel.trim() || 'Room Landmark',
      pos_x: 50.0,
      pos_y: 12.0,
      width: def.defaultWidth,
      height: def.defaultHeight,
      rotation: 0,
      metadata: {},
      is_active: true,
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    }

    setLocalFloorElements((prev) => [...prev, newElement])
    setHasUnsavedChanges(true)
    setIsAddLandmarkOpen(false)
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      {/* Floor Plan Canvas Toolbar & Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-2.5 rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#101726] p-3 text-xs">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
          <span className="font-heading font-extrabold text-sm text-white">
            {labName} Floor Canvas
          </span>

          <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-400">
            ({localWorkstations.length} Active Workstations &bull; {localFloorElements.length} Landmarks)
          </span>

          {saveMessage && (
            <span
              className={`rounded-lg px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold ${
                saveMessage.startsWith('Error')
                  ? 'bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300'
                  : 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300'
              }`}
            >
              {saveMessage}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Action Controls & Layout Mode Toggle */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
          {isPrivileged && (
            <>
              {isLayoutMode ? (
                <>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setIsAddModalOpen(true)}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-indigo-500/40 bg-indigo-500/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-300 hover:bg-indigo-500/20 transition-colors"
                  >
                    <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    <span>Add PC</span>
                  </button>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setIsAddLandmarkOpen(true)}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/40 bg-emerald-500/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-300 hover:bg-emerald-500/20 transition-colors"
                  >
                    <MapPin className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    <span>Add Landmark</span>
                  </button>

                  {hasUnsavedChanges && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleDiscardChanges}
                      className="rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/80 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-700"
                    >
                      Discard
                    </button>
                  )}

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    disabled={!hasUnsavedChanges || savingPositions}
                    onClick={handleSavePositions}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-emerald-500 shadow-md transition-all disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    {savingPositions ? (
                      <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                    ) : (
                      <Save className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    )}
                    <span>Save Layout</span>
                  </button>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (hasUnsavedChanges) {
                        if (confirm('Discard unsaved layout changes?')) {
                          handleDiscardChanges()
                          setIsLayoutMode(false)
                        }
                      } else {
                        setIsLayoutMode(false)
                      }
                    }}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300 hover:text-white"
                  >
                    <Lock className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    <span>Exit Layout Mode</span>
                  </button>
                </>
              ) : (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsLayoutMode(true)}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32] px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300 hover:border-indigo-500/40 hover:text-indigo-300 transition-colors"
                >
                  <Unlock className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  <span>Arrange Physical Layout</span>
                </button>
              )}

          <button

            onClick={onRefreshData}
            className="rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32] p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"

        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Interactive 16:9 Floor Plan Canvas Container */}
      <div
        ref={canvasRef}
        className="relative w-full aspect-[16/9] min-h-[380px] sm:min-h-[480px] rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#0B0F19] overflow-hidden select-none shadow-2xl"
        style={{

      >

        {isLayoutMode && (
          <div className="absolute top-12 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-30 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/50 bg-amber-950/80 px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-amber-200 shadow-xl backdrop-blur-md animate-pulse">
            <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-400" />

        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 flex-wrap">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">

          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">

    studentRoll?: string | null

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'specs' | 'rollcall' | 'issues' | 'report'>('specs')
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false)
  const [resolvingIssueId, setResolvingIssueId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [resolutionNotes, setResolutionNotes] = useState('')
  const [partsReplaced, setPartsReplaced] = useState('')
  const [createLogbookEntry, setCreateLogbookEntry] = useState(true)
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null)

  // Local optimistic resolved issues tracker
  const [resolvedIssueIds, setResolvedIssueIds] = useState<string[]>([])

  // Report form state

  const [issueTitle, setIssueTitle] = useState('')

  const [copiedSetupCmd, setCopiedSetupCmd] = useState(false)

    if (!isOpen) return

      if (e.key === 'Escape') {

    }

    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown)

        setActiveTab('rollcall')

    }

  }, [isOpen, workstation?.id, workstation?.status, workstation?.open_issues_count, assistanceRequest, onTogglePresence])

  useEffect(() => {

  ]

    if (cat) {

        setIssueTitle(cat.name)
      }

  }

  // 1. Toggle Attendance
  const handleToggleAttendance = (setPresent: boolean) => {
    if (isLocked || !rollNumber || !onTogglePresence) return
    setLocalPresence(setPresent)

  const handleReassignStudent = async () => {

      setIsSubmittingDisplaced(false)

    if (!issueTitle.trim()) {

        severity: issueSeverity,
        photos: issuePhotos,
      })

      if (!res.success) {

      setSuccessMessage('Problem reported successfully. Lab In-Charge has been notified.')

      setSubmitting(false)

  const handleResolveIssue = async (issueId: string) => {

    setErrorMessage(null)

      if (!res.success) {

      }

      // Optimistically hide the resolved issue immediately
      setResolvedIssueIds((prev) => [...prev, issueId])

          <div className="mx-5 mt-4 rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/40 bg-emerald-500/10 p-3 text-xs text-emerald-300">
            {successMessage}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Drawer Content Body */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-5 space-y-4">
          {/* ============================================================== */}
          {/* TAB 1: SILICON TELEMETRY & HARDWARE DIAGNOSTICS DECK           */}
          {/* ============================================================== */}
          {activeTab === 'specs' && (() => {
            const specs = workstation.hardware_specs as WorkstationHardwareSpecs | null
            const freeGb = specs ? specs.disk_c_free_gb : 0
            const totalGb = specs ? specs.disk_c_total_gb : 0
            const usedPct = specs
              ? Math.min(100, Math.max(5, specs.disk_c_used_pct || Math.round(((totalGb - freeGb) / (totalGb || 1)) * 100)))
              : 0
            const isLowDisk = freeGb < 15.0
            const isCriticalDisk = freeGb < 5.0

            return (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                {specs ? (
                  <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#0E1526] p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-xl space-y-4 relative overflow-hidden">
                    <div className="absolute -top-12 -right-12 w-40 h-40 bg-indigo-500/10 rounded-full blur-2xl pointer-events-none" />

                    {/* Telemetry Header */}
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/[0.06] pb-3.5">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div className="h-9 w-9 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/15 border border-indigo-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-indigo-400 shadow-sm">
                          <Cpu className="h-5 w-5" />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <h4 className="font-heading font-extrabold text-sm uppercase tracking-wider text-white">
                            Silicon Telemetry
                          </h4>
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                            Physical Node Architecture &amp; System Health
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-mono text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-500/30 px-3 py-1 rounded-full shadow-xs">
                        <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
                        <span>Agent Synced (v{specs.agent_version || '1.0.0'})</span>
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    {/* 2-Column Compute & Memory Bento Grid */}
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                      {/* Processor Core Card */}
                      <div className="rounded-xl bg-[#141E34] border border-white/[0.06] p-3.5 space-y-2">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <span className="text-[10.5px] uppercase font-mono tracking-wider text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            <Activity className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-400" />
                            Processor
                          </span>
                          <Badge className="bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300 border-indigo-500/30 text-[9.5px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0">
                            {specs.cpu_cores} Cores
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-white font-bold text-xs leading-snug line-clamp-2" title={specs.cpu}>
                          {specs.cpu}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono">
                          x64 Physical Compute Core
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Memory Card */}
                      <div className="rounded-xl bg-[#141E34] border border-white/[0.06] p-3.5 space-y-2">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <span className="text-[10.5px] uppercase font-mono tracking-wider text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            <Server className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-cyan-400" />
                            RAM Installed
                          </span>
                          <Badge className="bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/30 text-[9.5px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0">
                            Verified
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-white font-extrabold text-lg font-heading tracking-tight">
                          {specs.ram_gb} GB
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono">
                          DDR System Memory
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Storage Allocation & Headroom Meter (Drive C:) */}
                    <div className="rounded-xl bg-[#141E34] border border-white/[0.06] p-3.5 space-y-2.5">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                        <span className="font-mono text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5 font-medium">
                          <HardDrive className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                          System Volume (Drive C:)
                        </span>
                        <span className="font-mono font-bold text-white tabular-nums">
                          {specs.disk_c_free_gb} GB Free / {specs.disk_c_total_gb} GB
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      {/* Graduated Multi-Tone Bar */}
                      <div className="h-2.5 w-full rounded-full bg-[#0B0F19] overflow-hidden p-0.5 border border-white/5">
                        <div
                          className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-500 ${
                            isCriticalDisk
                              ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-rose-600 to-rose-400 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(244,63,94,0.6)] animate-pulse'
                              : isLowDisk
                              ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-600 to-amber-400 shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(245,158,11,0.5)]'
                              : 'bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 via-cyan-400 to-emerald-400 shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(16,185,129,0.4)]'
                          }`}
                          style={{ width: `${usedPct}%` }}
                        />
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-mono">
                        <span className="text-slate-400">
                          {usedPct}% Allocated ({(specs.disk_c_total_gb - specs.disk_c_free_gb).toFixed(1)} GB in use)
                        </span>
                        {isCriticalDisk ? (
                          <span className="text-rose-400 font-bold flex items-center gap-1 animate-pulse">
                            <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3 text-rose-400" />
                            <span>Storage Critical (&lt;5 GB Free)</span>
                          </span>
                        ) : isLowDisk ? (
                          <span className="text-amber-300 font-medium flex items-center gap-1">
                            <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3 text-amber-400" />
                            <span>Low Storage Warning (&lt;15 GB)</span>
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-emerald-400 font-medium flex items-center gap-1">
                            <CheckCircle2 className="h-3 w-3" />
                            <span>Optimal Headroom</span>
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* OS & Network Topology Ribbon */}
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs font-mono">
                      <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[#141E34] border border-white/[0.06] space-y-1">
                        <div className="text-[10px] uppercase text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <Monitor className="h-3 w-3 text-indigo-400" /> Operating System
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-slate-200 font-semibold text-[11.5px] truncate" title={specs.os_caption}>
                          {specs.os_caption}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                          Build {specs.os_build} â€¢ 64-bit Kernel
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[#141E34] border border-white/[0.06] space-y-1">
                        <div className="text-[10px] uppercase text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">

                        </div>
                        <div className="text-slate-200 font-semibold text-[11.5px]">
                          {specs.lan_ip}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                          MAC: {specs.mac_address}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Silicon TOFU Hardware Lock Card */}
                    {workstation.machine_guid ? (
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/25 bg-emerald-950/20 p-3.5 space-y-3">
                        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 flex-wrap">
                          <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                            <div className="h-7 w-7 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-emerald-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5 shadow-xs">
                              <ShieldCheck className="h-4 w-4" />
                            </div>
                            <div>
                              <div className="text-xs font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                <span>Silicon TOFU Lock Enforced</span>
                                <Badge className="bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/30 text-[9px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0">
                                  Anti-Spoof
                                </Badge>
                              </div>
                              <div className="text-[10.5px] text-slate-400 font-mono mt-0.5">
                                Bound to physical silicon ({workstation.machine_guid.slice(-17)}). Zero URL spoofing permitted.
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </div>

                          {isPrivileged && (
                            <div className="shrink-0">
                              {confirmResetLock ? (
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                  <Button
                                    type="button"
                                    variant="destructive"
                                    size="sm"
                                    disabled={isResettingLock}
                                    onClick={executeResetHardwareLock}
                                    className="h-8 px-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white font-bold text-xs gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-md"
                                  >
                                    <RotateCcw className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${isResettingLock ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
                                    <span>Confirm Unbind</span>
                                  </Button>
                                  <Button
                                    type="button"
                                    variant="ghost"
                                    size="sm"
                                    disabled={isResettingLock}
                                    onClick={() => setConfirmResetLock(false)}
                                    className="h-8 px-2.5 rounded-xl text-slate-400 hover:text-white text-xs cursor-pointer"
                                  >
                                    Cancel
                                  </Button>
                                </div>
                              ) : (
                                <Button
                                  type="button"
                                  variant="outline"
                                  size="sm"
                                  disabled={isResettingLock}
                                  onClick={() => setConfirmResetLock(true)}
                                  className="h-8 px-3 rounded-xl border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/10 hover:bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 font-bold text-xs gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition-colors shadow-xs"
                                  title="Unbind current hardware GUID to allow new physical machine pairing"
                                >
                                  <RotateCcw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                                  <span>Reset Hardware Lock</span>
                                </Button>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>

                        {confirmResetLock && (
                          <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-rose-950/40 border border-rose-500/30 text-[11px] text-rose-300">
                            <strong>Motherboard or NIC replaced?</strong> Resetting will release the cryptographic lock on {workstation.label}. The next computer executing <code className="font-mono text-white">labsync-agent.ps1</code> with station code &quot;{workstation.label}&quot; will automatically bind to this station.
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-950/15 p-3.5 space-y-2.5">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-amber-300 font-bold text-xs">
                          <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-400 shrink-0" />
                          <span>Awaiting Physical Machine Enrollment</span>
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 leading-relaxed">
                          This station is not locked to physical silicon. Run the client agent on the lab PC to bind telemetry and enforce anti-spoofing.
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-white/10 bg-[#0E1526]/50 p-6 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center space-y-3">
                    <div className="h-12 w-12 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-500/10 border border-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-400 flex items-center justify-center">
                      <Cpu className="h-6 w-6" />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="font-heading font-extrabold text-sm text-white">
                        No Hardware Telemetry Registered
                      </h4>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 max-w-sm mt-1 leading-relaxed">
                        Workstation <strong className="text-white font-mono">{workstation.label}</strong> has not yet synced with the native client agent.
                      </p>
                    </div>

                    <div className="w-full max-w-md pt-3 text-left space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10.5px] font-mono text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                        <span>Technician Enrollment Command:</span>
                        {copiedSetupCmd ? (
                          <span className="text-emerald-400 flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold">
                            <Check className="h-3 w-3" /> Copied
                          </span>
                        ) : null}
                      </div>
                      <div
                        onClick={() => {
                          navigator.clipboard?.writeText(
                            `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\\scripts\\client-agent\\labsync-agent.ps1 -StationCode "${workstation.label}"`
                          )
                          setCopiedSetupCmd(true)
                          setTimeout(() => setCopiedSetupCmd(false), 2500)
                        }}
                        className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-black/40 border border-white/5 font-mono text-[11px] text-indigo-300 hover:border-indigo-500/40 cursor-pointer select-all overflow-x-auto flex items-center justify-between gap-2"
                        title="Click to copy setup command"
                      >
                        <code className="truncate">
                          powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\client-agent\labsync-agent.ps1 -StationCode &quot;{workstation.label}&quot;
                        </code>
                        <Copy className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Direct Operational Quick Links */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 pt-1">
                  <Link
                    href={`/terminal/${encodeURIComponent(workstation.label)}`}
                    target="_blank"
                    className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.03] hover:bg-white/[0.06] border border-white/5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition-colors"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 truncate">
                      <Monitor className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-400 shrink-0" />
                      <span className="truncate">Student Gateway</span>
                    </div>
                    <ExternalLink className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-500 shrink-0" />
                  </Link>

                  <Link
                    href={`/maintenance?search=${encodeURIComponent(workstation.label)}`}
                    target="_blank"
                    className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.03] hover:bg-white/[0.06] border border-white/5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition-colors"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 truncate">
                      <Wrench className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-400 shrink-0" />
                      <span className="truncate">Service Logbook</span>
                    </div>
                    <ExternalLink className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-500 shrink-0" />
                  </Link>
                </div>
              </div>
            )
          })()}

          {/* ============================================================== */}
          {/* TAB 2: ROLL-CALL & SEATING ALLOCATION                           */}
          {/* ============================================================== */}
          {activeTab === 'rollcall' && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {student ? (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32] p-4 shadow-sm space-y-4">
                  {/* Seated Student Biographical Header */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className="h-12 w-12 rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-white/20 bg-slate-800 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-md">
                      {(student as any).photo_url ? (
                        <img
                          src={(student as any).photo_url}
                          alt={student.student_name}
                          className="h-full w-full object-cover"
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-sm font-bold text-indigo-300 font-heading">
                          {student.student_name.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                        <h4 className="font-heading font-extrabold text-base text-white truncate">
                          {student.student_name}
                        </h4>
                        <Badge className="bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300 border-indigo-500/30 font-mono text-[10.5px]">
                          Roll {student.roll_number}
                        </Badge>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                        {isTemporary ? (
                          <span className="text-amber-300 font-medium flex items-center gap-1">
                            <ArrowRightLeft className="h-3 w-3 inline shrink-0" />
                            Temporarily Relocated (Session Override)
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          'Baseline Cohort Seating Allocation'
                        )}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Attendance Controls */}
                  <div className="pt-3 border-t border-white/5 space-y-2.5">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                      <span className="text-slate-400 font-medium">Session Attendance Status:</span>
                      <Badge
                        className={
                          localPresence === false
                            ? 'bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-300 border-rose-500/30'
                            : 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/30'
                        }
                      >
                        {localPresence === false ? 'Marked Absent' : 'Marked Present'}
                      </Badge>
                    </div>

                    {onTogglePresence && (
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                        <Button
                          type="button"
                          variant="outline"
                          onClick={() => handleToggleAttendance(true)}
                          disabled={isLocked || localPresence === true}
                          className={`h-11 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold gap-2 cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                            localPresence === true
                              ? 'border-emerald-500/60 bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 shadow-sm'
                              : 'border-white/10 text-slate-300 hover:bg-white/5'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-400" />
                          <span>Mark Present</span>
                        </Button>

                        <Button
                          type="button"
                          variant="outline"
                          onClick={() => handleToggleAttendance(false)}
                          disabled={isLocked || localPresence === false}
                          className={`h-11 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold gap-2 cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                            localPresence === false
                              ? 'border-rose-500/60 bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 shadow-sm'
                              : 'border-white/10 text-slate-300 hover:bg-white/5'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <XCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-rose-400" />
                          <span>Mark Absent</span>
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* Tier 2 Temporary Reassignment */}
                  {onAssignOverride && (
                    <div className="pt-3 border-t border-white/5 space-y-2 text-xs">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span className="font-bold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider text-[10.5px]">
                          Temporary Reassign (Tier 2):
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">Today only</span>
                      </div>

                      {destinationStations.length === 0 ? (
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 italic">
                          No other operational vacant stations available for reassignment.
                        </p>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="flex gap-2">
                          <select
                            value={selectedTargetWsId}
                            onChange={(e) => setSelectedTargetWsId(e.target.value)}
                            className="flex-1 h-9 px-3 rounded-xl bg-[#0B0F19] border border-white/10 text-white text-xs"
                          >
                            {destinationStations.map((w) => (
                              <option key={w.id} value={w.id}>
                                {w.label} ({w.description || 'Empty & Operational'})
                              </option>
                            ))}
                          </select>
                          <Button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={handleReassignStudent}
                            disabled={isSubmittingOverride || !selectedTargetWsId}
                            className="h-9 px-3.5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-bold text-xs gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shrink-0 shadow-sm"
                          >
                            {isSubmittingOverride ? (
                              <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                            ) : (
                              <ArrowRightLeft className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                            )}
                            <span>Reassign</span>
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-white/5 bg-[#151E32]/50 p-6 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center space-y-4">
                  <div className="h-10 w-10 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-400 flex items-center justify-center">
                    <Monitor className="h-5 w-5" />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="font-heading font-semibold text-white text-sm">Station Available / Unassigned</h4>
                    <p className="mt-1 max-w-xs text-xs text-slate-400">
                      No student is currently assigned or seated at {workstation.label}.
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  {/* Assign Displaced Student if any are waiting */}
                  {onAssignReplacement && displacedStudents && displacedStudents.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="w-full max-w-md pt-4 border-t border-white/5 text-left space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span className="font-bold text-amber-300 uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <Users className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                          <span>Assign Waiting / Displaced Student ({displacedStudents.length})</span>
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">Tier 2 Quick Seat</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex gap-2">
                        <select
                          value={selectedDisplacedEnrollmentId}
                          onChange={(e) => setSelectedDisplacedEnrollmentId(e.target.value)}
                          className="flex-1 h-9 px-3 rounded-xl bg-[#0B0F19] border border-white/10 text-white text-xs truncate"
                        >
                          {displacedStudents.map((ds) => (
                            <option key={ds.enrollmentId} value={ds.enrollmentId}>
                              Roll {ds.rollNumber} â€” {ds.studentName} ({ds.originalWsLabel !== 'Unassigned' ? `Displaced from ${ds.originalWsLabel}` : 'Unassigned'})
                            </option>
                          ))}
                        </select>
                        <Button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={handleAssignDisplacedStudent}
                          disabled={isSubmittingDisplaced || !selectedDisplacedEnrollmentId}
                          className="h-9 px-3.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 text-white font-bold text-xs gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shrink-0 shadow-sm"
                        >
                          {isSubmittingDisplaced ? (
                            <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                          ) : (
                            <ArrowRightLeft className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                          )}
                          <span>Seat Here</span>
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Quick Link to Student Terminal Gateway */}
              <div className="pt-2">
                <Link
                  href={`/terminal/${encodeURIComponent(workstation.label)}`}
                  target="_blank"
                  className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.03] hover:bg-white/[0.06] border border-white/5 text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition-colors"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Monitor className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-400" />
                    <span>Open Student Terminal Gateway</span>
                  </div>
                  <ExternalLink className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-500" />
                </Link>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ============================================================== */}

'use client'

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react'
import {
  Search,
  CheckCircle2,
  ShieldAlert,
  Wrench,
  Monitor,
  Laptop,
  Layers,
  Map,
} from 'lucide-react'
import type { WorkstationWithIssues } from '@/types/workstations'

interface WorkstationMobileViewProps {
  workstations: WorkstationWithIssues[]
  onSelectWorkstation: (ws: WorkstationWithIssues) => void
  onToggleCanvasMode?: () => void
  isCanvasModeActive?: boolean
}

export function WorkstationMobileView({
  workstations,
  onSelectWorkstation,
  onToggleCanvasMode,
  isCanvasModeActive = false,
}: WorkstationMobileViewProps) {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('')
  const [selectedFilter, setSelectedFilter] = useState<string>('all')

  // Extract unique rows dynamically
  const rowLabels = useMemo(() => {
    const rows = new Set<string>()
    workstations.forEach((w) => {
      if (w.row_label) rows.add(w.row_label)
    })
    return Array.from(rows).sort()
  }, [workstations])

  // Filtered workstations
  const filteredWorkstations = useMemo(() => {
    return workstations.filter((ws) => {
      // 1. Search Query
      if (searchQuery.trim()) {
        const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim()
        const matchLabel = ws.label.toLowerCase().includes(q)
        const matchRow = ws.row_label?.toLowerCase().includes(q)
        const matchIssue = ws.active_issues?.some((i) => i.title.toLowerCase().includes(q))
        if (!matchLabel && !matchRow && !matchIssue) return false
      }

      // 2. Chip Filter
      if (selectedFilter === 'issues') {
        return ws.open_issues_count > 0
      }
      if (selectedFilter === 'operational') {
        return ws.open_issues_count === 0
      }
      if (selectedFilter !== 'all') {
        return ws.row_label === selectedFilter
      }

      return true
    })
  }, [workstations, searchQuery, selectedFilter])

  const flaggedCount = workstations.filter((w) => w.open_issues_count > 0).length

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      {/* Mobile Control Strip: Search & Canvas Toggle */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <div className="relative flex-1">
          <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search PC (e.g. PC-04)..."
            className="w-full rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32] pl-8 pr-3 py-2 text-xs text-white placeholder-slate-500 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none"
          />
          {searchQuery && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
              className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[10px] text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
            >
              Clear
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {onToggleCanvasMode && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onToggleCanvasMode}
            className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
              isCanvasModeActive
                ? 'border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300'
                : 'border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32] text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            {isCanvasModeActive ? (
              <>
                <Layers className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                <span>Grid View</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Map className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                <span>Floor Map</span>
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Filter Chips Bar */}
      <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-1 scrollbar-none">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setSelectedFilter('all')}
          className={`flex-shrink-0 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
            selectedFilter === 'all'
              ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
              : 'border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32] text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'
          }`}
        >
          All ({workstations.length})
        </button>

        {flaggedCount > 0 && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setSelectedFilter('issues')}
            className={`flex-shrink-0 flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${
              selectedFilter === 'issues'
                ? 'bg-rose-600 text-white'
                : 'border border-rose-500/30 bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400 hover:bg-rose-500/20'
            }`}
          >
            <ShieldAlert className="h-3 w-3" />
            <span>Issues ({flaggedCount})</span>
          </button>
        )}

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setSelectedFilter('operational')}
          className={`flex-shrink-0 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
            selectedFilter === 'operational'
              ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
              : 'border border-white/[0.08] bg-[#151E32] text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'
          }`}
        >
          Operational
        </button>

            {row}

                ledColor = 'bg-rose-500 animate-pulse shadow-[0_0_8px_#f43f5e]'
              } else {
                borderStyle = 'border-amber-500/80 bg-amber-950/20 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(245,158,11,0.2)]'
                ledColor = 'bg-amber-400 shadow-[0_0_6px_#fbbf24]'
              }

'use client'

import React, { useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Camera, Image as ImageIcon, X, Loader2, ZoomIn } from 'lucide-react'
import { compressImage } from '@/lib/image-compression'
import type { WorkstationPhoto } from '@/types/workstations'

interface WorkstationPhotoCaptureProps {
  photos: WorkstationPhoto[]
  onChange: (photos: WorkstationPhoto[]) => void
  maxPhotos?: number
  disabled?: boolean
}

export function WorkstationPhotoCapture({
  photos,
  onChange,
  maxPhotos = 3,
  disabled = false,
}: WorkstationPhotoCaptureProps) {
  const cameraInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)
  const [compressing, setCompressing] = useState(false)
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [lightboxUrl, setLightboxUrl] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const handleFiles = async (fileList: FileList | null) => {
    if (!fileList || fileList.length === 0) return
    if (photos.length >= maxPhotos) {
      setErrorMsg(`Maximum of ${maxPhotos} photos reached.`)
      return
    }

    setErrorMsg(null)
    setCompressing(true)

    try {
      const remainingSlots = maxPhotos - photos.length
      const filesToProcess = Array.from(fileList).slice(0, remainingSlots)
      const newPhotos: WorkstationPhoto[] = []

      for (const file of filesToProcess) {
        // Compress using client-side canvas utility
        const result = await compressImage(file, {
          maxDimension: 1200,
          quality: 0.72,
          maxFileSize: 2 * 1024 * 1024,
        })

        // Convert blob to base64 data URL for direct jsonb persistence
        const base64Url = await new Promise<string>((resolve, reject) => {
          const reader = new FileReader()
          reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result as string)
          reader.onerror = reject
          reader.readAsDataURL(result.file)
        })

        newPhotos.push({
          url: base64Url,
          name: result.file.name,
          size: result.compressedSize,
          thumbnailUrl: base64Url,
        })
      }

      onChange([...photos, ...newPhotos])
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to compress image'
      setErrorMsg(msg)
    } finally {
      setCompressing(false)
      // Reset inputs so user can pick the same file again if desired
      if (cameraInputRef.current) cameraInputRef.current.value = ''
      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = ''
    }
  }

  const removePhoto = (index: number) => {
    const updated = photos.filter((_, i) => i !== index)
    onChange(updated)
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <label className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">

        </label>
        <span className="text-[11px] tabular-nums text-slate-500">
          {photos.length} / {maxPhotos}
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Hidden Native Inputs */}
      <input
        ref={cameraInputRef}
        type="file"
        accept="image/*"
        capture="environment"
        className="hidden"
        disabled={disabled || compressing || photos.length >= maxPhotos}
        onChange={(e) => handleFiles(e.target.files)}
      />
      <input
        ref={fileInputRef}
        type="file"
        accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp"
        multiple
        className="hidden"
        disabled={disabled || compressing || photos.length >= maxPhotos}
        onChange={(e) => handleFiles(e.target.files)}
      />

      {/* Action Buttons */}
      {photos.length < maxPhotos && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          {/* Mobile Camera Button */}
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={disabled || compressing}
            onClick={() => cameraInputRef.current?.click()}
            className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-indigo-500/40 bg-indigo-500/5 px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-indigo-300 transition-colors hover:border-indigo-500/80 hover:bg-indigo-500/10 active:scale-[0.98] disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            {compressing ? (
              <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin text-indigo-400" />
            ) : (
              <Camera className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-400" />
            )}
            <span>Snap Camera</span>
          </button>

          {/* Gallery / File Picker */}
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={disabled || compressing}
            onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
            className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-700 bg-slate-900/60 px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 transition-colors hover:border-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-800 active:scale-[0.98] disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            <ImageIcon className="h-4 w-4 text-slate-400" />

          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      )}

        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 pt-1">
          {photos.map((photo, idx) => (
            <div
              key={idx}
              className="group relative aspect-video overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-slate-700 bg-slate-950"
            >

              />

              {/* View / Zoom Overlay */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setLightboxUrl(photo.url)}

              >
                <ZoomIn className="h-4 w-4 text-white drop-shadow" />
              </button>

              {/* Remove Button */}
              {!disabled && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation()
                    removePhoto(idx)
                  }}
                  className="absolute right-1 top-1 rounded-full bg-black/75 p-1 text-slate-300 backdrop-blur-sm transition-colors hover:bg-rose-600 hover:text-white"
                  title="Remove photo"
                >
                  <X className="h-3 w-3" />
                </button>
              )}

              {/* Size Badge */}

                  {(photo.size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Simple Lightbox Modal */}
      {lightboxUrl && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/80 p-4 backdrop-blur-sm"
          onClick={() => setLightboxUrl(null)}
        >

            >
              <X className="h-4 w-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
