export function DiagnosticsTriageHub({
  initialData,
  initialSearchQuery = '',
  onRefresh,
}: DiagnosticsTriageHubProps) {
  const [data, setData] = useState<DiagnosticsTriageData>(initialData)
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<'all' | 'open' | 'in_progress' | 'resolved'>('all')
  const [selectedStationFilter, setSelectedStationFilter] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState(initialSearchQuery)
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition()

  // Resolve Modal State
  const [resolvingIssue, setResolvingIssue] = useState<WorkstationIssueRecord | null>(null)
  const [resolutionNotes, setResolutionNotes] = useState('')
  const [partsReplaced, setPartsReplaced] = useState('')
  const [createLogbookEntry, setCreateLogbookEntry] = useState(true)
  const [actionError, setActionError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [actionSuccess, setActionSuccess] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const { workstations, issues, metrics } = data

  // Filtered issues list
  const filteredIssues = issues.filter((iss) => {
    if (statusFilter !== 'all' && iss.status !== statusFilter) return false
    if (selectedStationFilter && iss.workstation_label !== selectedStationFilter) return false
    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase()
      const matchTitle = iss.title.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      const matchStation = (iss.workstation_label || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
      const matchDesc = (iss.description || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
      const matchReporter = (iss.reported_by_name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
      if (!matchTitle && !matchStation && !matchDesc && !matchReporter) return false
    }
    return true
  })

  // Handle Sync / Refresh
  const handleSync = () => {
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        const fresh = await getDiagnosticsTriageData(data.lab_id || 'comp')
        setData(fresh)
        onRefresh?.()
      } catch (err: any) {
        console.error('Error refreshing diagnostics triage:', err)
      }
    })
  }

  // Keep internal state aligned when parent provides fresh initialData
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (initialData) {
      setData(initialData)
    }
  }, [initialData])

  // Continuous real-time auto-synchronization for Diagnostics & Triage Hub
  React.useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true
    let inFlight = false

    const autoSync = async (force: boolean = false) => {
      if (!isMounted || inFlight) return
      if (!force && typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.hidden) return
      inFlight = true
      try {
        const fresh = await getDiagnosticsTriageData(data.lab_id || 'comp')
        if (isMounted && fresh) {
          setData(fresh)
          onRefresh?.()
        }
      } catch {
        // Silently ignore transient network blips
      } finally {
        inFlight = false
      }
    }

    // 1. Continuous 10-second adaptive polling (checks visibility)
    const timer = setInterval(() => autoSync(false), 10000)

    // 2. Instant sync on focus / visibility return (forced)
    const handleVisibility = () => {
      if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && !document.hidden) {
        autoSync(true)
      }
    }
    const handleFocus = () => autoSync(true)
    window.addEventListener('focus', handleFocus)
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility)

    // 3. Instant real-time bus subscription across tabs/devices (forced, updates background tabs too!)
    const unsubWs = subscribeToSync('workstations', () => autoSync(true))
    const unsubAssist = subscribeToSync('assistance', () => autoSync(true))

    return () => {
      isMounted = false
      clearInterval(timer)
      window.removeEventListener('focus', handleFocus)
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility)
      unsubWs()
      unsubAssist()
    }
  }, [data.lab_id, onRefresh])

  // Handle Mark Under Repair
  const handleMarkUnderRepair = (issue: WorkstationIssueRecord) => {
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        const res = await updateWorkstationIssueStatus(issue.id, 'in_progress', 'Marked under technician repair')
        if (res.success) {
          setActionSuccess(`Workstation ${issue.workstation_label} is now marked Under Repair.`)
          setTimeout(() => setActionSuccess(null), 3000)
          // Optimistically update issue status
          setData((prev) => ({
            ...prev,
            issues: prev.issues.map((i) => (i.id === issue.id ? { ...i, status: 'in_progress' } : i)),
            workstations: prev.workstations.map((w) =>
              w.id === issue.workstation_id ? { ...w, status: 'under_repair' } : w
            ),
            metrics: {
              ...prev.metrics,
              open_count: Math.max(0, prev.metrics.open_count - 1),
              in_progress_count: prev.metrics.in_progress_count + 1,
              under_repair: prev.metrics.under_repair + 1,
              flagged: Math.max(0, prev.metrics.flagged - 1),
            },
          }))
          broadcastSync('workstations', { stationCode: issue.workstation_label })
          onRefresh?.()
        } else {
          setActionError(res.error || 'Failed to update issue status.')
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        setActionError(err.message || 'Error updating status.')
      }
    })
  }

  // Handle Resolve and Restore
  const handleConfirmResolve = async () => {
    if (!resolvingIssue) return
    if (!resolutionNotes.trim()) {
      setActionError('Resolution notes are required to certify issue closure.')
      return
    }

    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        const res = await resolveWorkstationIssue({
          issue_id: resolvingIssue.id,
          resolution_notes: resolutionNotes.trim(),
          create_maintenance_log: createLogbookEntry,
          parts_replaced: partsReplaced.trim() || null,
        })

        if (res.success) {
          setActionSuccess(`Resolved: Workstation ${resolvingIssue.workstation_label} restored to Operational.`)
          setTimeout(() => setActionSuccess(null), 3500)
          setResolvingIssue(null)
          setResolutionNotes('')
          setPartsReplaced('')

          // Optimistically update
          setData((prev) => ({
            ...prev,
            issues: prev.issues.map((i) =>
              i.id === resolvingIssue.id
                ? {
                    ...i,
                    status: 'resolved',
                    resolution_notes: resolutionNotes.trim(),
                    resolved_at: new Date().toISOString(),
                  }
                : i
            ),
            workstations: prev.workstations.map((w) =>
              w.id === resolvingIssue.workstation_id ? { ...w, status: 'operational', open_issues_count: 0 } : w
            ),
            metrics: {
              ...prev.metrics,
              open_count:
                resolvingIssue.status === 'open'
                  ? Math.max(0, prev.metrics.open_count - 1)
                  : prev.metrics.open_count,
              in_progress_count:
                resolvingIssue.status === 'in_progress'
                  ? Math.max(0, prev.metrics.in_progress_count - 1)
                  : prev.metrics.in_progress_count,
              resolved_count: prev.metrics.resolved_count + 1,
              operational: prev.metrics.operational + 1,
              under_repair:
                resolvingIssue.status === 'in_progress'
                  ? Math.max(0, prev.metrics.under_repair - 1)
                  : prev.metrics.under_repair,
              flagged:
                resolvingIssue.status === 'open' ? Math.max(0, prev.metrics.flagged - 1) : prev.metrics.flagged,
            },
          }))
          broadcastSync('workstations', { stationCode: resolvingIssue.workstation_label })
          onRefresh?.()
        } else {
          setActionError(res.error || 'Failed to resolve issue.')
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        setActionError(err.message || 'Error resolving issue.')
      }
    })
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5 font-sans">
      {/* Action Feedback Alerts */}
      {actionSuccess && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/10 px-4 py-2.5 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-emerald-300 shadow-sm animate-in fade-in duration-200">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
            <span className="font-semibold">{actionSuccess}</span>
          </div>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setActionSuccess(null)} className="text-emerald-400 hover:text-white">
            <X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {actionError && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-rose-500/30 bg-rose-500/10 px-4 py-2.5 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-rose-300 shadow-sm animate-in fade-in duration-200">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-rose-400 shrink-0" />
            <span className="font-semibold">{actionError}</span>
          </div>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setActionError(null)} className="text-rose-400 hover:text-white">
            <X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 1. HIGH-DENSITY FLEET TELEMETRY CARDS (Rule #10: ~76px 2-row layout) */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5 sm:gap-3">
        {/* Total Stations */}
        <div className="glass-card p-2.5 sm:p-3 rounded-xl flex flex-col justify-between h-[76px]">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-400">
                <Monitor className="h-3 w-3" />
              </span>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold text-zinc-400 dark:text-slate-400">
                Total Fleet
              </span>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-white/[0.04]">
              {data.lab_name}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between mt-1">
            <span className="text-xl sm:text-[22px] font-extrabold font-heading text-zinc-950 dark:text-white tabular-nums">
              {metrics.total}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-sans">
              Monitored Nodes
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Operational Ready */}
        <div className="glass-card p-2.5 sm:p-3 rounded-xl flex flex-col justify-between h-[76px]">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400">
                <CheckCircle2 className="h-3 w-3" />
              </span>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                Operational
              </span>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-emerald-500/10">
              {metrics.total > 0 ? Math.round((metrics.operational / metrics.total) * 100) : 100}% Health
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between mt-1">
            <span className="text-xl sm:text-[22px] font-extrabold font-heading text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 tabular-nums">
              {metrics.operational}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-sans">
              Ready for Class
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Awaiting Triage / Open Issues */}
        <div
          onClick={() => setStatusFilter(statusFilter === 'open' ? 'all' : 'open')}
          className={`glass-card p-2.5 sm:p-3 rounded-xl flex flex-col justify-between h-[76px] cursor-pointer transition-all hover:border-amber-500/40 ${
            metrics.open_count > 0 ? 'border-amber-500/30' : ''
          }`}
          title="Filter to Open / Awaiting Triage issues"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className={`flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-md ${
                metrics.open_count > 0 ? 'bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-500' : 'bg-zinc-500/10 text-zinc-400'
              }`}>
                <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3" />
              </span>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold text-zinc-400 dark:text-slate-400">
                Awaiting Triage
              </span>
            </div>
            <span className={`text-[10px] font-mono font-bold px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded ${
              metrics.open_count > 0 ? 'bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-400' : 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-white/[0.04] text-zinc-400'
            }`}>
              {metrics.open_count === 0 ? 'Nominal' : `${metrics.open_count} Open`}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between mt-1">
            <span className={`text-xl sm:text-[22px] font-extrabold font-heading tabular-nums ${
              metrics.open_count > 0 ? 'text-amber-500' : 'text-zinc-950 dark:text-white'
            }`}>
              {metrics.open_count}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-sans">
              {metrics.open_count > 0 ? 'Reported by Staff' : 'Zero Open Faults'}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Active Under Repair */}
        <div
          onClick={() => setStatusFilter(statusFilter === 'in_progress' ? 'all' : 'in_progress')}
          className={`glass-card p-2.5 sm:p-3 rounded-xl flex flex-col justify-between h-[76px] cursor-pointer transition-all hover:border-rose-500/40 ${
            metrics.in_progress_count > 0 ? 'border-rose-500/30' : ''
          }`}
          title="Filter to stations currently Under Repair"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className={`flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-md ${
                metrics.in_progress_count > 0 ? 'bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-500' : 'bg-zinc-500/10 text-zinc-400'
              }`}>
                <Wrench className="h-3 w-3" />
              </span>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold text-zinc-400 dark:text-slate-400">
                Under Repair
              </span>
            </div>
            <span className={`text-[10px] font-mono font-bold px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded ${
              metrics.in_progress_count > 0 ? 'bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-400' : 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-white/[0.04] text-zinc-400'
            }`}>
              {metrics.in_progress_count === 0 ? 'Clear' : `${metrics.in_progress_count} Active`}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between mt-1">
            <span className={`text-xl sm:text-[22px] font-extrabold font-heading tabular-nums ${
              metrics.in_progress_count > 0 ? 'text-rose-500' : 'text-zinc-950 dark:text-white'
            }`}>
              {metrics.in_progress_count}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-sans">
              {metrics.in_progress_count > 0 ? 'Technician Active' : 'Full Availability'}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. COMPACT HARDWARE FLEET RADAR (PURE TECHNICAL BEACONS - ZERO STUDENT ROSTERS) */}
      <div className="glass-card rounded-2xl p-4 space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Monitor className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-400" />
            <h3 className="font-heading font-extrabold text-sm text-zinc-950 dark:text-white">
              Hardware Fleet Radar
            </h3>
            <span className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              (Live status for {workstations.length} workstations â€” click any node to filter issues)
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-slate-400">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 shadow-[0_0_6px_rgba(16,185,129,0.7)]" />
              <span>Operational</span>
            </span>
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-amber-500" />
              <span>Flagged Fault</span>
            </span>
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-rose-500 animate-pulse" />
              <span>Under Repair</span>
            </span>
            {selectedStationFilter && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelectedStationFilter(null)}
                className="text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-400 hover:text-white underline cursor-pointer ml-2"
              >
                Clear Node Filter ({selectedStationFilter})
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Compact Terminal Chips Grid */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-6 sm:grid-cols-8 md:grid-cols-12 lg:grid-cols-16 gap-1.5 pt-1">
          {workstations.map((ws) => {
            const isSelected = selectedStationFilter === ws.label
            const isUnderRepair = ws.status === 'under_repair'
            const isFlagged = ws.status === 'flagged'

            let bgClass = 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-[#151E32] text-zinc-700 dark:text-slate-300 border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/10'
            let dotClass = 'bg-emerald-500'

            if (isUnderRepair) {
              bgClass = 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-500/40 ring-1 ring-rose-500/30 dark:ring-rose-500/50'
              dotClass = 'bg-rose-500 animate-pulse'
            } else if (isFlagged) {
              bgClass = 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-500/40'
              dotClass = 'bg-amber-500'
            }

            if (isSelected) {
              bgClass += ' ring-2 ring-indigo-500 shadow-md shadow-indigo-500/30'
            }

            return (
              <button
                key={ws.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelectedStationFilter(isSelected ? null : ws.label)}
                title={`${ws.label}: ${ws.status.toUpperCase()} (${ws.open_issues_count} open issues)`}
                className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-1.5 rounded-lg border text-center transition-all cursor-pointer hover:scale-105 ${bgClass}`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span className={`h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${dotClass}`} />
                  <span className="font-mono text-[10px] font-bold tracking-tight">
                    {ws.label}
                  </span>
                </div>
                {ws.open_issues_count > 0 && (
                  <span className="text-[9px] font-mono px-1 py-0 rounded bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 mt-0.5 font-bold">
                    {ws.open_issues_count} {ws.open_issues_count === 1 ? 'issue' : 'issues'}
                  </span>
                )}
              </button>
            )
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 3. REPORTED ISSUES RESOLVER BOARD */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        {/* Toolbar & Filter Tabs */}
        <div className="p-3 sm:p-4 border-b border-zinc-200/60 dark:border-zinc-800 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-zinc-50/50 dark:bg-zinc-900/50">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 p-1 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 flex-wrap">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setStatusFilter('all')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                statusFilter === 'all'
                  ? 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-950 dark:text-white shadow-xs'
                  : 'text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <span>All Issues</span>
              <span className="font-mono text-[11px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800">
                {issues.length}
              </span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setStatusFilter('open')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                statusFilter === 'open'
                  ? 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 shadow-xs'
                  : 'text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <AlertTriangle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-amber-500" />
              <span>Awaiting Triage</span>
              <span className="font-mono text-[11px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-400 font-bold">
                {metrics.open_count}
              </span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setStatusFilter('in_progress')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                statusFilter === 'in_progress'
                  ? 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 shadow-xs'
                  : 'text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <Wrench className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-rose-500" />
              <span>Under Repair</span>
              <span className="font-mono text-[11px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-400 font-bold">
                {metrics.in_progress_count}
              </span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setStatusFilter('resolved')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                statusFilter === 'resolved'
                  ? 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shadow-xs'
                  : 'text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-500" />
              <span>Resolved &amp; Closed</span>
              <span className="font-mono text-[11px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400 font-bold">
                {metrics.resolved_count}
              </span>
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Input
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search issues, PC label, symptoms..."
              className="h-8.5 w-full sm:w-64 text-xs bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
            />
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              disabled={isPending}
              onClick={handleSync}
              className="h-8.5 px-3 text-xs rounded-xl border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 gap-1.5 shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
              title="Sync latest live workstation health and fault tickets from database"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${isPending ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">Sync</span>
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Issues List / Table */}
        <div className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800/60">
          {filteredIssues.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-14 text-center text-zinc-500 space-y-2">
              <ShieldCheck className="h-8 w-8 mx-auto text-emerald-500/70" />
              <p className="font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 text-xs">
                {statusFilter === 'all'
                  ? 'No reported workstation issues on file.'
                  : `No issues in "${statusFilter.replace('_', ' ')}" state.`}
              </p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
                All reported hardware and software faults filed by teachers appear here for technician triage.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            filteredIssues.map((issue) => {
              const isResolved = issue.status === 'resolved'

'use client'

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useTransition } from 'react'
import {
  Wrench,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  AlertTriangle,
  RotateCcw,
  CheckCheck,
  Search,
  Filter,
  Monitor,
  LayoutGrid,
  MapPin,
  Sparkles,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronRight,
  X,
  FileCheck2,
  AlertCircle,
  HelpCircle,
  Info,
  Check,
  PauseCircle,
  FileText,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import {
  FleetTerminalStatus,
  FleetProgressMap,
  FleetProgressSummary,
  calculateFleetProgressSummary,
  sortWorkstationLabels,
  groupWorkstationLabelsByRow,
} from '@/lib/types/maintenance-fleet'
import {
  getFleetRoutineProgress,
  updateFleetTerminalStatus,
  batchUpdateFleetTerminalStatus,
  resetFleetRoutineProgress,
  archiveFleetRoutineToLog,
} from '@/app/actions/maintenance-fleet'
import type { MaintenancePlanRecord } from '@/app/actions/maintenance'

interface FleetRoutineModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean
  onClose: () => void
  onSuccess?: () => void
  plan: MaintenancePlanRecord
}

interface WorkstationCoordinate {
  id: string
  label: string
  pos_x: number
  pos_y: number
  row_label?: string | null
}

export default function FleetRoutineModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
  plan,
}: FleetRoutineModalProps) {
  const [activeView, setActiveView] = useState<'grid' | 'floor'>('grid')
  const [selectedRow, setSelectedRow] = useState<string>('all')
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<'all' | 'pending' | 'completed' | 'blocked'>('all')
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('')
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition()

  // Routine execution state
  const [targetMachines, setTargetMachines] = useState<string[]>([])
  const [fleetProgress, setFleetProgress] = useState<FleetProgressMap>({})
  const [workstations, setWorkstations] = useState<WorkstationCoordinate[]>([])
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true)
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null)

  // Block note editing state
  const [editingBlockedStation, setEditingBlockedStation] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [blockedNoteInput, setBlockedNoteInput] = useState('')

  // SOP Checklist expanded
  const [showChecklist, setShowChecklist] = useState(false)

  // Archival Modal Confirmation State
  const [isArchiveModalOpen, setIsArchiveModalOpen] = useState(false)
  const [archiveRemarks, setArchiveRemarks] = useState('')
  const [archiveParts, setArchiveParts] = useState('')
  const [isArchiving, setIsArchiving] = useState(false)

  // 1. Fetch initial progress on open
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen || !plan.id) return
    let isMounted = true

    async function loadData() {
      setIsLoading(true)
      setErrorMsg(null)
      try {
        const res = await getFleetRoutineProgress(plan.id)
        if (!isMounted) return
        if (res.success && res.plan) {
          setTargetMachines(res.plan.targetMachines || [])
          setFleetProgress(res.plan.fleetProgress || {})
          setWorkstations(res.workstations || [])
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (!isMounted) return
        setErrorMsg(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to load fleet maintenance data')
      } finally {
        if (isMounted) setIsLoading(false)
      }
    }

    loadData()
    return () => {
      isMounted = false
    }
  }, [isOpen, plan.id])

  // Computed summary
  const summary: FleetProgressSummary = useMemo(() => {
    return calculateFleetProgressSummary(targetMachines, fleetProgress)
  }, [targetMachines, fleetProgress])

  // Row groups
  const rowGroups = useMemo(() => {
    return groupWorkstationLabelsByRow(targetMachines)
  }, [targetMachines])

  // Filtered machines
  const filteredMachines = useMemo(() => {
    return targetMachines.filter((label) => {
      // Row filter
      if (selectedRow !== 'all') {
        const matchingGroup = rowGroups.find((g) => g.rowLabel === selectedRow)
        if (matchingGroup && !matchingGroup.items.includes(label)) {
          return false
        }
      }

      // Status filter
      const entry = fleetProgress[label]
      const status = entry?.status || 'pending'
      if (statusFilter !== 'all' && status !== statusFilter) {
        return false
      }

      // Search query
      if (searchQuery.trim()) {
        const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase()
        const matchLabel = label.toLowerCase().includes(q)
        const matchNote = (entry?.notes || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
        if (!matchLabel && !matchNote) return false
      }

      return true
    })
  }, [targetMachines, fleetProgress, selectedRow, statusFilter, searchQuery, rowGroups])

  // Cycle machine status: pending -> completed -> blocked -> pending
  const handleCycleStatus = (label: string, e?: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e?.stopPropagation()
    const current = fleetProgress[label]?.status || 'pending'
    let next: FleetTerminalStatus = 'completed'
    if (current === 'completed') next = 'blocked'
    else if (current === 'blocked') next = 'pending'
    else next = 'completed'

    if (next === 'blocked') {
      // Open quick note input
      setEditingBlockedStation(label)
      setBlockedNoteInput(fleetProgress[label]?.notes || '')
    }

    // Optimistic update
    setFleetProgress((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [label]: {
        ...prev[label],
        status: next,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
    }))

    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await updateFleetTerminalStatus(plan.id, label, next)
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to update terminal status:', err)
      }
    })
  }

  // Save blocked note
  const handleSaveBlockedNote = () => {
    if (!editingBlockedStation) return
    const station = editingBlockedStation
    const note = blockedNoteInput.trim()

    setFleetProgress((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [station]: {
        ...prev[station],
        status: 'blocked',
        notes: note,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
    }))

    setEditingBlockedStation(null)

    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await updateFleetTerminalStatus(plan.id, station, 'blocked', note)
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to save blocked note:', err)
      }
    })
  }

  // Batch action: Mark current filtered stations completed
  const handleBatchMarkCompleted = () => {
    const toUpdate = filteredMachines.filter((label) => fleetProgress[label]?.status !== 'completed')
    if (toUpdate.length === 0) return

    setFleetProgress((prev) => {
      const next = { ...prev }
      toUpdate.forEach((label) => {
        next[label] = {
          ...next[label],
          status: 'completed',
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        }
      })
      return next
    })

    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await batchUpdateFleetTerminalStatus(plan.id, toUpdate, 'completed')
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to batch update terminals:', err)
      }
    })
  }

  // Batch action: Reset current filtered stations to pending
  const handleBatchResetPending = () => {
    const toUpdate = filteredMachines.filter((label) => fleetProgress[label]?.status !== 'pending')
    if (toUpdate.length === 0) return

    setFleetProgress((prev) => {
      const next = { ...prev }
      toUpdate.forEach((label) => {
        next[label] = {
          ...next[label],
          status: 'pending',
          notes: '',
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        }
      })
      return next
    })

    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await batchUpdateFleetTerminalStatus(plan.id, toUpdate, 'pending')
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to batch reset terminals:', err)
      }
    })
  }

  // Reset entire routine
  const handleResetEntireRoutine = () => {
    if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to reset all terminals in this routine back to Pending?')) {
      return
    }

    setFleetProgress((prev) => {
      const next: FleetProgressMap = {}
      targetMachines.forEach((label) => {
        next[label] = { status: 'pending', updated_at: new Date().toISOString() }
      })
      return next
    })

    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await resetFleetRoutineProgress(plan.id)
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to reset routine progress:', err)
      }
    })
  }

  // Archive to official log
  const handleConfirmArchive = async () => {
    setIsArchiving(true)
    try {
      const res = await archiveFleetRoutineToLog({
        planId: plan.id,
        remarks: archiveRemarks.trim() || undefined,
        partsReplaced: archiveParts.trim() || undefined,
      })
      if (res.success) {
        setIsArchiveModalOpen(false)
        onSuccess?.()
        onClose()
      } else {
        alert(res.error || 'Failed to archive maintenance log')
      }
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Error archiving maintenance log')
    } finally {
      setIsArchiving(false)
    }
  }

  if (!isOpen) return null

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-5 overflow-y-auto font-sans animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-[#0B0F19] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl w-full max-w-5xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
        {/* 1. COMPACT PURPOSE-BUILT HEADER */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50/50 dark:bg-zinc-900/40 flex items-start justify-between gap-4 shrink-0">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[11px] font-bold bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-500/20">
                <Wrench className="h-3 w-3" />
                Fleet Execution Routine
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                {plan.category || 'General Routine'}
              </span>
              <span className="text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-700">â€¢</span>
              <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 uppercase">
                {plan.lab_id === 'comp' ? 'Computer Lab 01' : plan.lab_id}
              </span>
            </div>
            <h2 className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-heading font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">
              {plan.title}
            </h2>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 transition cursor-pointer"
            title="Close"
          >
            <X className="h-5 w-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* 2. HIGH-DENSITY KPI STRIP (RULE #10 & RULE #7) */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5 p-3 sm:px-5 bg-white dark:bg-[#0B0F19] border-b border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-800 shrink-0">
          {/* Progress Gauge */}
          <div className="glass-card p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800/80 flex flex-col justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">

                <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />

            </div>

                <Clock className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />

            </div>
            <div className="mt-1">

                {summary.pending}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 ml-1.5">
                remaining PCs
              </span>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-mono">
              Ready for technician
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Blocked */}
          <div className="glass-card p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-rose-500/20 bg-rose-500/5 flex flex-col justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-semibold text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <AlertTriangle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Blocked / Issues
              </span>
              <span className="font-mono text-[10px]">Action req</span>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-1">
              <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-heading font-extrabold text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 tabular-nums">
                {summary.blocked}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 ml-1.5">
                hardware/OS blocks
              </span>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-rose-500 font-mono">
              {summary.blocked > 0 ? 'Requires attention' : 'Zero blocks'}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 3. SOP CHECKLIST ACCORDION */}
        {plan.checklist && plan.checklist.length > 0 && (
          <div className="px-5 py-2 bg-zinc-50/80 dark:bg-zinc-900/30 border-b border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-800 shrink-0 text-xs">

            >
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <FileText className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-500" />

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 pt-2 pb-1 animate-in slide-in-from-top-1 duration-150">

                  >
                    <span className="h-4 w-4 rounded-full bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                      {idx + 1}

        {/* 4. CONTROLS TOOLBAR: TABS, ROW FILTERS, BATCH ACTIONS */}

            <div className="bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 p-0.5 rounded-xl flex items-center border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs">

              <button

                onClick={() => setActiveView('floor')}

                    : 'text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'

            </div>

            {activeView === 'grid' && (

                <button

                  onClick={() => setSelectedRow('all')}
                  className={`px-2 py-1 rounded-lg transition cursor-pointer ${
                    selectedRow === 'all'
                      ? 'bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-zinc-950 font-bold'
                      : 'text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800'

                >
                  All Rows
                </button>

                  <button
                    key={rg.rowLabel}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setSelectedRow(rg.rowLabel)}

                      selectedRow === rg.rowLabel
                        ? 'bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-zinc-950 font-bold'
                        : 'text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {rg.rowLabel}
                  </button>

              </div>
            )}

          {/* Quick Search & Batch Controls */}

              <Search className="h-3.5 w-3.5 absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400" />

                placeholder="Search PC..."

              />
            </div>

            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={handleBatchMarkCompleted}
              disabled={isPending || filteredMachines.length === 0}
              className="h-8 px-2.5 text-xs rounded-lg gap-1 border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-500/10 cursor-pointer"

              <CheckCheck className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">Mark Visible Complete</span>
            </Button>

            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={handleBatchResetPending}
              disabled={isPending || filteredMachines.length === 0}
              className="h-8 px-2.5 text-xs rounded-lg gap-1 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 cursor-pointer"
              title="Reset visible stations to pending"
            >
              <RotateCcw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">Reset</span>
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 5. MAIN CONTENT AREA */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 sm:p-5 bg-zinc-50/50 dark:bg-[#070A11]">
          {isLoading ? (
            <div className="py-20 text-center space-y-3">
              <div className="inline-block animate-spin h-8 w-8 border-2 border-indigo-500 border-t-transparent rounded-full" />
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">Loading terminal fleet data...</p>
            </div>
          ) : errorMsg ? (
            <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/20 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 text-xs text-center space-y-2">
              <AlertTriangle className="h-5 w-5 mx-auto" />
              <p>{errorMsg}</p>
            </div>
          ) : activeView === 'grid' ? (
            /* VIEW A: MACHINE GRID VIEW */
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 md:grid-cols-6 lg:grid-cols-8 gap-2.5">
                {filteredMachines.map((label) => {
                  const entry = fleetProgress[label]
                  const status = entry?.status || 'pending'
                  const isCompleted = status === 'completed'
                  const isBlocked = status === 'blocked'

                  return (
                    <div
                      key={label}
                      onClick={(e) => handleCycleStatus(label, e)}
                      className={`relative p-2.5 rounded-xl border transition-all cursor-pointer select-none flex flex-col justify-between min-h-[92px] group ${
                        isCompleted
                          ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-500/30 dark:bg-emerald-500/5 hover:border-emerald-500/50'
                          : isBlocked
                          ? 'bg-rose-500/10 border-rose-500/30 dark:bg-rose-500/5 hover:border-rose-500/50'
                          : 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900/80 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 hover:border-indigo-500/40 hover:shadow-xs'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {/* Top Row: Icon + Label */}
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span className="font-heading font-extrabold text-xs text-zinc-900 dark:text-white group-hover:text-indigo-400 transition">
                          {label}
                        </span>
                        {isCompleted ? (
                          <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-500 shrink-0" />
                        ) : isBlocked ? (
                          <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-rose-500 shrink-0 animate-pulse" />
                        ) : (
                          <Clock className="h-4 w-4 text-zinc-400 shrink-0" />
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {/* Middle Note or Info */}
                      <div className="my-1">
                        {isBlocked ? (
                          <p className="text-[10px] text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 font-medium line-clamp-2 leading-tight">
                            {entry?.notes || 'Blocked / Needs Attention'}
                          </p>
                        ) : isCompleted ? (
                          <p className="text-[10px] text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 font-medium">
                            âœ“ Serviced
                          </p>
                        ) : (
                          <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
                            Tap to complete
                          </p>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {/* Bottom Micro Status Bar */}
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800/60 text-[9.5px]">
                        <span
                          className={`font-semibold capitalize ${
                            isCompleted
                              ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400'
                              : isBlocked
                              ? 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400'
                              : 'text-zinc-400'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {status}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-[9px] text-zinc-400 opacity-60 group-hover:opacity-100">
                          cycle â‡„
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )
                })}
              </div>

              {filteredMachines.length === 0 && (
                <div className="py-16 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 space-y-1">
                  <Filter className="h-6 w-6 mx-auto text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-700" />
                  <p>No workstations matching your active filters.</p>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            /* VIEW B: INTERACTIVE CAD FLOOR PLAN VIEW */
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 px-1">
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <MapPin className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-400" />
                  <span>Interactive Room Floor Plan â€” Click any desk to cycle maintenance status</span>
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] font-mono">
                  Scale: 100% Floor Bounds
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Blueprint Canvas Box */}
              <div className="relative w-full h-[460px] sm:h-[500px] bg-white dark:bg-[#090D16] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden p-4 shadow-inner">
                {/* Visual Grid Lines */}
                <div
                  className="absolute inset-0 opacity-15 pointer-events-none"
                  style={{
                    backgroundImage:
                      'radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.4) 1px, transparent 0)',
                    backgroundSize: '24px 24px',
                  }}
                />

                {/* Front Whiteboard / Podium Bar */}
                <div className="absolute top-2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-48 h-3 bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 rounded-full border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <span className="text-[8px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-500">
                    Whiteboard / Front Wall
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* Workstation Nodes on CAD Canvas */}
                {workstations.map((ws) => {
                  const entry = fleetProgress[ws.label]
                  const status = entry?.status || 'pending'
                  const isCompleted = status === 'completed'
                  const isBlocked = status === 'blocked'
                  const isTeacher = ws.label.toLowerCase().includes('teacher') || ws.label.toLowerCase().includes('podium')

                  return (
                    <div
                      key={ws.id}
                      onClick={(e) => handleCycleStatus(ws.label, e)}
                      style={{
                        left: `${ws.pos_x}%`,
                        top: `${ws.pos_y}%`,
                        transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
                      }}
                      className={`absolute cursor-pointer transition-transform hover:scale-110 select-none z-10 flex flex-col items-center group`}
                    >
                      {/* Node Pill */}
                      <div
                        className={`h-9 px-2 min-w-[54px] rounded-lg border shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-all ${
                          isCompleted
                            ? 'bg-emerald-500 text-white border-emerald-400 font-bold'
                            : isBlocked
                            ? 'bg-rose-500 text-white border-rose-400 font-bold animate-pulse'
                            : 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700'
                        } ${isTeacher ? 'ring-2 ring-indigo-500' : ''}`}
                      >
                        {isCompleted ? (
                          <Check className="h-3 w-3 stroke-[3]" />
                        ) : isBlocked ? (
                          <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3" />
                        ) : (
                          <Clock className="h-3 w-3 text-zinc-400" />
                        )}
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold tracking-tight">
                          {ws.label}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      {/* Tooltip on hover */}
                      <div className="hidden group-hover:block absolute -top-7 bg-zinc-900 text-white text-[9.5px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md whitespace-nowrap shadow-md z-30 pointer-events-none">
                        {status.toUpperCase()} â€¢ Click to cycle
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* 6. BOTTOM ACTION BAR: ARCHIVE AS CERTIFIED LOG & DISMISS */}
        <div className="p-3 sm:p-4 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900/90 border-t border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={handleResetEntireRoutine}
              className="h-9 px-3 text-xs rounded-xl text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-rose-600 dark:hover:text-rose-400 hover:border-rose-500/30 cursor-pointer"

              <RotateCcw className="h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-1" />
              <span>Reset All Progress</span>

            <span className="text-xs text-zinc-400 hidden sm:inline">
              Progress auto-saves to database in real-time.
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="h-9 px-4 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl cursor-pointer"
            >
              Keep In-Progress & Close
            </Button>

            <Button
              type="button"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => setIsArchiveModalOpen(true)}
              className="h-9 px-4 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white shadow-xs cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5"
            >
              <FileCheck2 className="h-4 w-4" />
              <span>Archive as Certified Log</span>
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* MODAL 1: BLOCKED ISSUE REASON NOTE */}
      {editingBlockedStation && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-60 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-xl p-5 max-w-sm w-full space-y-4 shadow-xl">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-rose-500" />
                <span>Flag Workstation Block: {editingBlockedStation}</span>
              </h3>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setEditingBlockedStation(null)}
                className="text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600"
              >
                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">
              Provide brief technical diagnostic reason why this PC could not be serviced (e.g. Broken monitor, OS corrupt, Blue Screen).
            </p>

            <Input
              type="text"
              placeholder="e.g. BSOD on boot, no network cable"
              value={blockedNoteInput}
              onChange={(e) => setBlockedNoteInput(e.target.value)}
              className="text-xs rounded-lg"
              autoFocus
            />

            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-1">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => setEditingBlockedStation(null)}
                className="h-8 text-xs rounded-lg"
              >
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                onClick={handleSaveBlockedNote}
                className="h-8 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white"
              >
                Save Block Reason
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* MODAL 2: ARCHIVE AS CERTIFIED SERVICE LOG CONFIRMATION */}
      {isArchiveModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-60 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6 max-w-md w-full space-y-4 shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 pb-3">
              <h3 className="text-base font-heading font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                <FileCheck2 className="h-5 w-5 text-indigo-500" />
                <span>Archive Fleet Service Log</span>
              </h3>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsArchiveModalOpen(false)}
                className="text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600"
              >
                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2 text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
              <p>
                This action will write an official certified maintenance log into{' '}
                <strong className="text-zinc-900 dark:text-white font-mono">public.maintenance_logs</strong> with complete audit verification.
              </p>

              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-700/80 space-y-1 text-xs">
                <div className="flex justify-between font-medium">
                  <span>Routine:</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">{plan.title}</span>
                </div>

'use client'

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react'
import {
  Wrench,
  CheckSquare2,
  Square,
  AlertCircle,
  Calendar,
  Package,
  X,
  Sparkles,
  CheckCircle2,
  Monitor,
  Clock,
  Layers,
  ShieldCheck,
  Grid,
  FileText,
  AlertTriangle,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'
import { NepaliDatePicker } from '@/components/ui/nepali-date-picker'
import {
  MaintenancePlanRecord,
  MaintenanceReminderRecord,
  logMaintenanceService,
} from '@/app/actions/maintenance'
import WorkstationMatrixSelector from './workstation-matrix-selector'
import { useUserScope } from '@/hooks/use-user-scope'
import { useInfrastructureState } from '@/hooks/use-infrastructure-state'
import { getNepaliDate } from '@/lib/nepali-date'

interface LogMaintenanceModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean
  onClose: () => void
  onSuccess: () => void
  reminder?: MaintenanceReminderRecord | null
  plan?: MaintenancePlanRecord | null
  plans: MaintenancePlanRecord[]
  selectedLabId?: string
}

export default function LogMaintenanceModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
  reminder,
  plan,
  plans,
  selectedLabId,
}: LogMaintenanceModalProps) {
  const { profile } = useUserScope()
  const { labs } = useInfrastructureState()
  const [selectedPlanId, setSelectedPlanId] = useState<string>('')
  const [labId, setLabId] = useState<string>(selectedLabId || 'comp')
  const currentLab = useMemo(() => labs.find((l) => l.id === labId), [labs, labId])
  const labCapacity = currentLab?.capacity || 40
  const isComputerOrTechLab = currentLab?.type === 'computer_lab' || currentLab?.type === 'electronics_lab' || labId === 'comp' || labId === 'elec'

  const [useMatrix, setUseMatrix] = useState<boolean>(true)
  const [flaggedStations, setFlaggedStations] = useState<string[]>([])
  const [assetIdentifier, setAssetIdentifier] = useState<string>('')
  const [workPerformed, setWorkPerformed] = useState<string>('')
  const [partsReplaced, setPartsReplaced] = useState<string>('')
  const [serviceDate, setServiceDate] = useState<string>(new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0])
  const [completedChecklist, setCompletedChecklist] = useState<string[]>([])
  const [remarks, setRemarks] = useState<string>('')
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState<boolean>(false)
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const nepaliDateStr = useMemo(() => {
    try {
      const d = new Date(serviceDate)
      return getNepaliDate(d).formattedDate
    } catch {
      return ''
    }
  }, [serviceDate])

  const handleMatrixChange = (data: {
    serviced: string[]
    flagged: string[]
    summaryText: string
  }) => {
    setFlaggedStations(data.flagged)
    if (useMatrix) {
      setAssetIdentifier(data.summaryText)
    }
  }

  // Pre-fill state when plan, reminder, or modal is opened
  useEffect(() => {
    if (plan) {
      setSelectedPlanId(plan.id)
      setLabId(plan.lab_id)
      if (plan.checklist && Array.isArray(plan.checklist)) {
        setCompletedChecklist([...plan.checklist])
      } else {
        setCompletedChecklist([])
      }
      setAssetIdentifier(
        plan.lab_id === 'comp'
          ? 'All Workstations (PC 01â€“36)'
          : `${plan.title} Equipment`
      )
      setWorkPerformed(`Completed periodic routine maintenance for ${plan.title}.`)
    } else if (reminder) {
      setSelectedPlanId(reminder.plan_id)
      setLabId(reminder.lab_id)
      if (reminder.plan?.checklist && Array.isArray(reminder.plan.checklist)) {
        setCompletedChecklist([...reminder.plan.checklist])
      } else {
        setCompletedChecklist([])
      }
      setAssetIdentifier(
        reminder.lab_id === 'comp'
          ? 'All Workstations (PC 01â€“36)'
          : `All Systems / ${reminder.title}`
      )
      setWorkPerformed(`Completed periodic routine maintenance for ${reminder.title}.`)
    } else {
      const targetLab = selectedLabId && selectedLabId !== 'all' ? selectedLabId : 'comp'
      setSelectedPlanId(plans[0]?.id || '')
      setLabId(targetLab)
      setUseMatrix(targetLab === 'comp')
      setAssetIdentifier('')
      setWorkPerformed('')
      setCompletedChecklist([])
    }
    setErrorMsg(null)
  }, [plan, reminder, plans, selectedLabId, isOpen])

  // When plan changes, populate checklist from plan definition
  const handlePlanChange = (planId: string) => {
    setSelectedPlanId(planId)
    const targetPlan = plans.find((p) => p.id === planId)
    if (targetPlan) {
      setLabId(targetPlan.lab_id)
      setUseMatrix(targetPlan.lab_id === 'comp')
      if (Array.isArray(targetPlan.checklist)) {
        setCompletedChecklist([...targetPlan.checklist])
      }
    }
  }

  const toggleChecklistItem = (item: string) => {
    setCompletedChecklist((prev) =>
      prev.includes(item) ? prev.filter((i) => i !== item) : [...prev, item]
    )
  }

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!assetIdentifier.trim()) {
      setErrorMsg('Target machine(s) or hardware identifier is required.')
      return
    }
    if (!workPerformed.trim()) {
      setErrorMsg('A summary of technical work completed is required.')
      return
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true)
    setErrorMsg(null)

    try {
      const res = await logMaintenanceService({
        plan_id: selectedPlanId || null,
        reminder_id: reminder?.id || null,
        lab_id: labId,
        asset_identifier: assetIdentifier.trim(),
        work_performed: workPerformed.trim(),
        checklist_completed: completedChecklist,
        parts_replaced: partsReplaced.trim() || null,
        cost_incurred: 0,
        service_date: serviceDate,
        remarks: remarks.trim() || null,
      })

      if (!res.success) {
        setErrorMsg(res.error || 'Failed to record maintenance.')
      } else {
        onSuccess()
        onClose()
      }
    } catch (err: any) {

        {/* Header */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-between bg-zinc-50/50 dark:bg-zinc-900/50">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="h-10 w-10 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 flex items-center justify-center border border-indigo-500/20 shadow-xs">
              <Wrench className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-zinc-950 dark:text-white">
                  Log Lab Maintenance
                </h3>
                {reminder && (
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800">
                    Linked to Reminder
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">
                Record completed PC servicing, cleaning, or updates; auto-schedules next cycle.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="h-8 w-8 rounded-lg text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="h-4 w-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Form Content */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-5 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto flex-1">
          {errorMsg && (
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/20 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 text-xs flex items-center gap-2">
              <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
              <span>{errorMsg}</span>

          )}

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3.5">

              <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" />
              <span>{isSubmitting ? 'Saving...' : 'Save & Schedule Next Cycle'}</span>
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  )

    setSelectedPlanForFleet(plan)
    setIsFleetModalOpen(true)
  }

  const handleRefresh = useCallback(() => {
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        const [freshOverview, freshTriage] = await Promise.all([
          getMaintenanceOverview(selectedLab),
          getDiagnosticsTriageData(selectedLab),
        ])
        setData(freshOverview)
        if (freshTriage) setTriageData(freshTriage)
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to refresh maintenance data:', err)
      }
    })
  }, [selectedLab])

    const unsubWs = subscribeToSync('workstations', () => handleRefresh())
    const unsubAssist = subscribeToSync('assistance', () => handleRefresh())

    const handleFocus = () => handleRefresh()
    const handleVisibility = () => {
      if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && !document.hidden) {
        handleRefresh()
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener('focus', handleFocus)
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility)

'use client'

import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import {
  Search,
  Filter,
  Calendar,
  Wrench,
  Printer,
  ChevronRight,
  UserCheck,
  CheckCircle2,
  FileText,
  Clock,
  Monitor,
  Download,
  ChevronDown,
  FileSpreadsheet,
  Sparkles,
} from 'lucide-react'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'
import { MaintenanceLogRecord, exportMaintenanceRecordsAction } from '@/app/actions/maintenance'

interface MaintenanceLedgerTableProps {
  logs: MaintenanceLogRecord[]
  selectedLab: string
  onSelectLab: (labId: string) => void
  onSelectLog: (log: MaintenanceLogRecord) => void
}

export default function MaintenanceLedgerTable({
  logs,
  selectedLab,
  onSelectLab,
  onSelectLog,
}: MaintenanceLedgerTableProps) {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('')
  const [exportMenuOpen, setExportMenuOpen] = useState(false)
  const [isExporting, setIsExporting] = useState(false)
  const [toastMsg, setToastMsg] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const dropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(event: MouseEvent) {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setExportMenuOpen(false)
      }
    }
    if (exportMenuOpen) {
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside)
      return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside)
    }
  }, [exportMenuOpen])

  const showToast = (msg: string) => {
    setToastMsg(msg)
    setTimeout(() => setToastMsg(null), 3500)
  }

  const downloadFile = (base64Data: string, filename: string, contentType: string) => {
    const byteCharacters = atob(base64Data)
    const byteNumbers = new Array(byteCharacters.length)
    for (let i = 0; i < byteCharacters.length; i++) {
      byteNumbers[i] = byteCharacters.charCodeAt(i)
    }
    const byteArray = new Uint8Array(byteNumbers)
    const blob = new Blob([byteArray], { type: contentType })
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob)
    const a = document.createElement('a')
    a.href = url
    a.download = filename
    document.body.appendChild(a)
    a.click()
    document.body.removeChild(a)
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url)
  }

  const handleExport = async (format: 'xlsx' | 'csv') => {
    setIsExporting(true)
    setExportMenuOpen(false)
    try {
      showToast(`Generating certified ${format.toUpperCase()} export...`)
      const res = await exportMaintenanceRecordsAction(selectedLab, format)
      if (res.success && res.base64 && res.filename && res.contentType) {
        downloadFile(res.base64, res.filename, res.contentType)
        showToast(`Downloaded ${res.filename}`)
      } else {
        showToast(`Export failed: ${res.error || 'Unknown error'}`)
      }
    } catch (e: unknown) {
      const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Unknown error'
      showToast(`Export failed: ${msg}`)
    } finally {
      setIsExporting(false)
    }
  }

  const handleOpenPrint = () => {
    setExportMenuOpen(false)
    const params = new URLSearchParams()
    if (selectedLab !== 'all') params.set('lab_id', selectedLab)
    window.open(`/print/maintenance?${params.toString()}`, '_blank')
  }

  // Filter logs by selected lab and search term
  const filteredLogs = useMemo(() => {
    return logs.filter((log) => {
      if (selectedLab !== 'all' && log.lab_id !== selectedLab) {
        return false
      }
      if (searchTerm.trim()) {
        const query = searchTerm.toLowerCase()
        const matchAsset = log.asset_identifier?.toLowerCase().includes(query)
        const matchWork = log.work_performed?.toLowerCase().includes(query)
        const matchTech = log.performed_by_name?.toLowerCase().includes(query)
        const matchPlan = log.plan_title?.toLowerCase().includes(query)
        return matchAsset || matchWork || matchTech || matchPlan
      }
      return true
    })
  }, [logs, selectedLab, searchTerm])

  return (
    <div className="bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl shadow-xs overflow-hidden font-sans relative">
      {/* Toast */}
      {toastMsg && (
        <div className="fixed top-5 right-5 z-50 bg-zinc-950 text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-zinc-950 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl shadow-2xl text-xs font-mono font-medium flex items-center gap-2 border border-zinc-700 animate-in slide-in-from-top-2 duration-150">
          <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-400" />
          <span>{toastMsg}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Table Toolbar */}
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-zinc-50/50 dark:bg-zinc-800/30">
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-950 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
            <FileText className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-500" />
            Lab Maintenance & Servicing Records
          </h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-subtext text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-300 mt-0.5">
            Audit history of completed computer servicing, BIOS/software updates, cleaning, and routine checks.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Search & Export Dropdown */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5 w-full sm:w-auto">
          <div className="relative flex-1 sm:w-64">
            <Search className="h-3.5 w-3.5 absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400 dark:text-slate-400" />
            <Input
              value={searchTerm}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search machines, staff, or notes..."
              className="h-8 pl-8 text-xs bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Standardized Export Dropdown */}
          <div className="relative" ref={dropdownRef}>
            <Button
              onClick={() => setExportMenuOpen(!exportMenuOpen)}
              disabled={isExporting || logs.length === 0}
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              className="h-8 px-3 text-xs gap-1.5 shrink-0 bg-zinc-900 text-white hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-white font-medium shadow-xs transition-transform active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Download className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              <span>{isExporting ? 'Exporting...' : 'Export Records'}</span>
              <ChevronDown className={`h-3 w-3 transition-transform ${exportMenuOpen ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
            </Button>

            {exportMenuOpen && (
              <div className="absolute right-0 mt-2 w-64 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-xl z-30 p-1.5 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-100 font-sans">
                <div className="px-3 py-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 text-[10px] font-mono uppercase text-zinc-400 dark:text-slate-400 font-bold">
                  Official Institutional Exports
                </div>

                {/* Excel */}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleExport('xlsx')}
                  className="w-full text-left px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 flex items-start gap-2.5 transition-colors group cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <div className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform mt-0.5">
                    <FileSpreadsheet className="h-4 w-4" />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                      Excel Workbook (.xlsx)
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                      Two-phase layout, SOP checklist, frozen panes & certifications
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </button>

                {/* CSV */}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleExport('csv')}
                  className="w-full text-left px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 flex items-start gap-2.5 transition-colors group cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <div className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-sky-500/10 text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400 group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform mt-0.5">
                    <FileText className="h-4 w-4" />

interface PrintMaintenanceViewProps {
  data: MaintenanceOverviewData
  labId: string
}

export default function PrintMaintenanceView({ data, labId }: PrintMaintenanceViewProps) {
  const [densityMode, setDensityMode] = useState<PrintDensityMode>(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        const saved = localStorage.getItem('lmr_print_density_mode') as PrintDensityMode | null
        if (saved === 'compact' || saved === 'detailed') return saved
      } catch {}
    }
    return 'detailed'
  })

  const labDisplayName =
    labId === 'comp'
      ? 'Computer Engineering Lab 01'
      : labId === 'phys'
      ? 'Physics Laboratory'
      : labId === 'chem'
      ? 'Chemistry Laboratory'
      : labId === 'bio'
      ? 'Biology Laboratory'
      : labId === 'elec'
      ? 'Electronics Laboratory'
      : 'All Institutional Laboratories (Consolidated)'

  const logs = data?.logs || []

  // Extract column specs
  const colDate = maintenanceReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'service_date')!
  const colFacility = maintenanceReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'facility')!
  const colAsset = maintenanceReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'asset')!
  const colWork = maintenanceReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'routine_work')!
  const colChecklist = maintenanceReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'checklist')!
  const colStaff = maintenanceReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'staff')!
  const colNextDue = maintenanceReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'next_due')!

  // Dynamic footnote generation & word-boundary truncation
  const { computedLogs, footnotes } = useMemo(() => {
    const notes: FootnoteEntry[] = []

    const processed = logs.map((log: any, idx: number) => {
      const rowId = `Row #${idx + 1} (${log.service_date} | ${log.lab_name || log.lab_id})`

      const rawWork = log.work_performed || log.remarks || 'Routine check completed'
      let workDisplay = rawWork
      let workFootnoteIdx: number | null = null

      if (rawWork && rawWork.trim().length > 0) {
        const maxWork = colWork.print[densityMode].maxChars
        const res = truncateAtWordBoundary(rawWork, maxWork)
        if (res.truncated) {
          const fnIdx = notes.length + 1
          workFootnoteIdx = fnIdx
          notes.push({
            index: fnIdx,
            rowIdentifier: rowId,
            fieldName: 'Work Performed',
            fullText: rawWork.trim(),
          })
          workDisplay = res.text
        }
      }

      return {
        ...log,
        _workDisplay: workDisplay,
        _workFootnoteIdx: workFootnoteIdx,
      }
    })

    return { computedLogs: processed, footnotes: notes }
  }, [logs, densityMode, colWork])

  return (
    <PrintLayout
      icon={Wrench}
      title="Official Lab Maintenance & Servicing Logbook"
      subtitle="A4 landscape sheet for maintenance routines and service history."
      backHref="/maintenance"
      backLabel="Back to Maintenance"
      printButtonLabel="Print Logbook (A4 Landscape)"
      printButtonColorClass="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700"
      densityMode={densityMode}
      onDensityModeChange={setDensityMode}
      headerSubtitle="NEPAL GOVERNMENT RECOGNIZED â€¢ VOCATIONAL & TECHNICAL EDUCATION"
      nepaliName={INSTITUTION_CONFIG.nameNepali}
      headerFacilityName={labDisplayName}
      headerAcademicYear={INSTITUTION_CONFIG.academicYear}
      documentTitleBadge="OFFICIAL LAB MAINTENANCE & COMPUTER SERVICING LOGBOOK"
      signatureTier="3-tier"
      footerNote="Certified Lab Maintenance & Computer Servicing Logbook"
      footnotes={footnotes}
      subHeaderBanner={
        <div className="mb-6 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-end gap-3 font-sans">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-base font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-900">

            </h2>
