import ExcelJS from 'exceljs'
import type { RawRosterRow, ParsedRosterRow } from './types'

/**
 * Normalizes header strings for flexible column matching
 */
function normalizeHeader(header: string): string {
  return header.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '')
}

function matchColumnType(
  header: string
): 'roll' | 'name' | 'adm' | 'reg' | 'gender' | 'contact' | null {
  const norm = normalizeHeader(header)
  if (['roll', 'rollno', 'rollnumber', 'sn', 'snno', 'symbolno'].includes(norm)) {
    return 'roll'
  }
  if (['name', 'studentname', 'fullname', 'nameofstudent'].includes(norm)) {
    return 'name'
  }
  // Matches RFID No., Card No., Student ID, or Admission No.
  if (
    [
      'rfid',
      'rfidno',
      'rfidnumber',
      'cardno',
      'smartcardno',
      'admissionno',
      'admissionnumber',
      'admno',
      'admnumber',
      'studentid',
      'admid',
      'idno',
    ].includes(norm)
  ) {
    return 'adm'
  }
  if (['registrationno', 'registrationnumber', 'regno', 'regnumber', 'boardreg', 'boardregno'].includes(norm)) {
    return 'reg'
  }
  if (['gender', 'sex'].includes(norm)) {
    return 'gender'
  }
  if (['contact', 'phone', 'phoneno', 'mobile', 'guardianphone', 'contactno'].includes(norm)) {
    return 'contact'
  }
  return null
}

/**
 * Parses CSV text into raw key-value rows
 */
function parseCsvContent(csvText: string): RawRosterRow[] {
  const lines = csvText.split(/\r?\n/).map((l) => l.trim()).filter((l) => l.length > 0)
  if (lines.length < 2) return []

  // Split lines accounting for quotes
  const parseLine = (line: string): string[] => {
    const result: string[] = []
    let cur = ''
    let inQuotes = false

    for (let i = 0; i < line.length; i++) {
      const c = line[i]
      if (c === '"') {
        inQuotes = !inQuotes
      } else if (c === ',' && !inQuotes) {
        result.push(cur.trim())
        cur = ''
      } else {
        cur += c
      }
    }
    result.push(cur.trim())
    return result
  }

  // Find header line
  let headerIndex = -1
  let colMap: {
    roll?: number
    name?: number
    adm?: number
    reg?: number
    gender?: number
    contact?: number
  } = {}

  for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(lines.length, 10); i++) {
    const cols = parseLine(lines[i])
    const found: typeof colMap = {}
    cols.forEach((col, idx) => {
      const match = matchColumnType(col)
      if (match === 'roll') found.roll = idx
      if (match === 'name') found.name = idx
      if (match === 'adm') found.adm = idx
      if (match === 'reg') found.reg = idx
      if (match === 'gender') found.gender = idx
      if (match === 'contact') found.contact = idx
    })

    // Student Name is the ONLY required column to identify a valid roster header
    if (found.name !== undefined) {
      headerIndex = i
      colMap = found
      break
    }
  }

  if (headerIndex === -1) {
    throw new Error("Could not find required header ('Full Name' or 'Student Name') in CSV file.")
  }

  const rows: RawRosterRow[] = []
  for (let i = headerIndex + 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const cols = parseLine(lines[i])
    if (cols.length === 0 || cols.every((c) => c === '')) continue

    const rollVal = colMap.roll !== undefined ? cols[colMap.roll] : null
    const nameVal = colMap.name !== undefined ? cols[colMap.name] : null
    const admVal = colMap.adm !== undefined ? cols[colMap.adm] : null
    const regVal = colMap.reg !== undefined ? cols[colMap.reg] : null
    const genderVal = colMap.gender !== undefined ? cols[colMap.gender] : null
    const contactVal = colMap.contact !== undefined ? cols[colMap.contact] : null

    rows.push({
      roll_number: rollVal,
      full_name: nameVal,
      admission_no: admVal,
      registration_no: regVal,
      gender: genderVal,
      contact: contactVal,
    })
  }

  return rows
}

/**
 * Parses Excel workbook (.xlsx / .xls) buffer into raw key-value rows
 */
async function parseExcelBuffer(buffer: Buffer): Promise<RawRosterRow[]> {
  const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook()
  await workbook.xlsx.load(buffer as any)

  const worksheet = workbook.worksheets[0]
  if (!worksheet) {
    throw new Error('Spreadsheet contains no worksheets.')
  }

  let headerRowIndex = -1
  let colMap: {
    roll?: number
    name?: number
    adm?: number
    reg?: number
    gender?: number
    contact?: number
  } = {}

  // Scan first 15 rows for header row
  worksheet.eachRow({ includeEmpty: false }, (row, rowNumber) => {
    if (headerRowIndex !== -1 || rowNumber > 15) return

    const found: typeof colMap = {}
    row.eachCell({ includeEmpty: false }, (cell, colNumber) => {
      const text = cell.text?.toString() || ''
      const match = matchColumnType(text)
      if (match === 'roll') found.roll = colNumber
      if (match === 'name') found.name = colNumber
      if (match === 'adm') found.adm = colNumber
      if (match === 'reg') found.reg = colNumber
      if (match === 'gender') found.gender = colNumber
      if (match === 'contact') found.contact = colNumber
    })

    // Student Name is the ONLY mandatory column
    if (found.name !== undefined) {
      headerRowIndex = rowNumber
      colMap = found
    }
  })

  if (headerRowIndex === -1) {
    throw new Error("Could not find required column header ('Student Name' or 'Full Name') in worksheet.")
  }

  const rows: RawRosterRow[] = []
  worksheet.eachRow({ includeEmpty: false }, (row, rowNumber) => {
    if (rowNumber <= headerRowIndex) return

    const rollCell = colMap.roll ? row.getCell(colMap.roll) : null
    const nameCell = colMap.name ? row.getCell(colMap.name) : null
    const admCell = colMap.adm ? row.getCell(colMap.adm) : null
    const regCell = colMap.reg ? row.getCell(colMap.reg) : null
    const genderCell = colMap.gender ? row.getCell(colMap.gender) : null
    const contactCell = colMap.contact ? row.getCell(colMap.contact) : null

    const rollText = rollCell?.text?.trim() || ''
    const nameText = nameCell?.text?.trim() || ''
    const admText = admCell?.text?.trim() || ''
    const regText = regCell?.text?.trim() || ''
    const genderText = genderCell?.text?.trim() || ''
    const contactText = contactCell?.text?.trim() || ''

    // Skip entirely blank rows
    if (!rollText && !nameText && !admText && !regText && !genderText && !contactText) return

    rows.push({
      roll_number: rollText,
      full_name: nameText,
      admission_no: admText,
      registration_no: regText,
      gender: genderText,
      contact: contactText,
    })
  })

  return rows
}

/**
 * Universal multi-format spreadsheet parser (.xlsx, .xls, .csv)
 */
export async function parseRosterFile(
  fileBuffer: Buffer,
  fileName: string
): Promise<ParsedRosterRow[]> {
  const isCsv = fileName.toLowerCase().endsWith('.csv')
  const rawRows: RawRosterRow[] = isCsv
    ? parseCsvContent(fileBuffer.toString('utf8'))
    : await parseExcelBuffer(fileBuffer)

  if (rawRows.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('The uploaded spreadsheet does not contain any student rows.')
  }

  // Convert raw rows to clean structured ParsedRosterRows
  const parsedRows: ParsedRosterRow[] = []

  rawRows.forEach((row, idx) => {
    const rowIndex = idx + 1

    // Extract roll number as integer (defaults to null if absent/not provided)
    let rollNum: number | null = null
    if (typeof row.roll_number === 'number') {
      rollNum = Math.floor(row.roll_number)
    } else if (typeof row.roll_number === 'string' && row.roll_number.trim() !== '') {
      const match = row.roll_number.match(/\d+/)
      rollNum = match ? parseInt(match[0], 10) : null
    }

    const cleanName = (row.full_name || '').trim()
    const cleanAdm = (row.admission_no || '').trim() || null
    const cleanReg = (row.registration_no || '').trim() || null

    // Normalize optional gender
    let cleanGender: 'male' | 'female' | 'other' | null = null
    if (row.gender) {
      const gNorm = row.gender.toString().toLowerCase().trim()
      if (gNorm.startsWith('m')) cleanGender = 'male'
      else if (gNorm.startsWith('f')) cleanGender = 'female'
      else if (gNorm.startsWith('o')) cleanGender = 'other'
    }

    const cleanContact = (row.contact || '').toString().trim() || null

    parsedRows.push({
      row_index: rowIndex,
      roll_number: rollNum,
      full_name: cleanName,
      admission_no: cleanAdm,
      registration_no: cleanReg,
      gender: cleanGender,
      contact: cleanContact,
    })
  })

  return parsedRows
}

/**
 * Roster Ingestion and Cohort Lifecycle Types
 * Strict 4-column LMS specification: Roll Number, Full Name, Admission No, Registration No
 */

export type IngestionMode = 'sync' | 'clean_slate'

export interface RawRosterRow {
  roll_number?: number | string | null
  full_name?: string | null
  admission_no?: string | null
  registration_no?: string | null
  gender?: string | null
  contact?: string | null
}

export interface ParsedRosterRow {
  row_index: number
  roll_number: number | null
  full_name: string
  admission_no: string | null
  registration_no: string | null
  gender?: 'male' | 'female' | 'other' | null
  contact?: string | null
}

export type RowValidationStatus =
  | 'valid_new'          // Clean new student person entity + cohort enrollment
  | 'valid_existing'     // Existing student (matched by strong ID) + new cohort enrollment
  | 'valid_retained'     // Existing student already enrolled with same roll (idempotent retention)
  | 'valid_roll_update'  // Existing student matched, safe roll shift/swap in cohort
  | 'review_needed'      // Advisory review (e.g. name similarity or changed name on same roll)
  | 'warning'            // Advisory warning
  | 'error'              // Blocking fatal error (duplicate roll, collision, identifier mismatch)

export interface ValidationRowPreview {
  row_index: number
  roll_number: number | null
  full_name: string
  admission_no: string | null
  is_auto_admission_no?: boolean
  registration_no: string | null
  gender?: 'male' | 'female' | 'other' | null
  contact?: string | null
  status: RowValidationStatus
  matched_student_id?: string | null
  matched_student_name?: string | null
  old_roll_number?: number | null
  diff_badge?: 'matched_exact' | 'roll_changed' | 'name_typo' | 'brand_new' | 'collision'
  error_message?: string | null
  warning_message?: string | null
  existing_student_id?: string | null
  existing_student_name?: string | null
  existing_admission_no?: string | null
  match_confidence?: 'admission_exact' | 'name_only' | 'none'
  user_override_decision?: 'confirm_match' | 'treat_as_new'
}

export interface UnmatchedExistingStudent {
  id: string
  student_id: string
  roll_number: number
  full_name: string
  admission_no: string | null
  registration_no: string | null
  workstation_label?: string | null
}

export interface RosterBuckets {
  bucket1_auto_confirmed: ValidationRowPreview[]
  bucket2_review_needed: ValidationRowPreview[]
  bucket3_clean_new: ValidationRowPreview[]
  bucket4_unmatched_existing: UnmatchedExistingStudent[]
}

export interface RosterPreflightReport {
  target_academic_year_id: string
  target_academic_year_name: string
  target_class_id: string
  target_class_name: string
  mode: IngestionMode
  clean_slate_eligible: boolean
  existing_cohort_count: number
  existing_attendance_logs_count: number
  total_rows: number
  valid_count: number
  new_students_count: number
  existing_students_count: number
  retained_enrollments_count: number
  updated_enrollments_count: number
  warning_count: number
  error_count: number
  can_commit: boolean
  buckets: RosterBuckets
  rows: ValidationRowPreview[]
}

export interface RosterCommitResult {
  success: boolean
  mode?: IngestionMode
  processed_rows: number
  students_created: number
  students_matched: number
  enrollments_created: number
  enrollments_retained: number
  enrollments_updated?: number
  error?: string
}

export interface IngestionPayloadRow {

  ParsedRosterRow,
  ValidationRowPreview,
  RosterPreflightReport,
  IngestionMode,
  UnmatchedExistingStudent,
} from './types'
import {
  formatStudentDisplayName,
  normalizeStudentName,
  calculateNameSimilarity,
} from '../imports/string-normalization'

export interface DatabaseValidationContext {
  targetAcademicYearId: string
  targetAcademicYearName: string
  targetClassId: string
  targetClassName: string
  // Existing students in institution
  existingStudentsByAdmissionNo: Map<
    string,
    { id: string; full_name: string; admission_no: string | null; registration_no: string | null }
  >
  existingStudentsByRegistrationNo: Map<
    string,
    { id: string; full_name: string; admission_no: string | null; registration_no: string | null }
  >
  allActiveStudents: Array<{ id: string; full_name: string; admission_no: string | null }>
  // Existing enrollments in target cohort (academic_year_id, class_id)
  existingEnrollmentsByStudentId: Map<string, { id: string; roll_number: number }>
  existingEnrollmentsByRoll: Map<
    number,
    { id: string; student_id: string; full_name: string; admission_no: string | null; registration_no: string | null }
  >
  existingCohortStudents?: Array<UnmatchedExistingStudent>
  existingAttendanceLogsCount?: number
  mode?: IngestionMode
}

/**
 * Checks exact normalized name match (including token permutations like "Sharma Aarav" vs "Aarav Sharma")
 * without fuzzy Levenshtein blurring, avoiding silent identity mixups.
 */
export function isExactNormalizedNameMatch(nameA: string, nameB: string): boolean {
  const normA = normalizeStudentName(nameA)
  const normB = normalizeStudentName(nameB)
  if (!normA || !normB) return false
  if (normA === normB) return true
  const tokensA = normA.split(' ').sort().join(' ')
  const tokensB = normB.split(' ').sort().join(' ')
  return tokensA === tokensB
}

/**
 * Formats a clean sequential institutional admission number:
 * Format: ADM-[YEAR]-[SEQ]
 * Example: ADM-2083-0001
 * Completely decoupled from mutable class names or roll numbers.
 */
export function formatSequentialAdmissionNo(
  academicYearId: string,
  seq: number
): string {
  const cleanYear = (academicYearId || '').toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '')
  const padSeq = String(seq).padStart(seq < 1000 ? 4 : 5, '0')
  return `ADM-${cleanYear}-${padSeq}`
}

/**
 * Legacy compatibility alias for formatAutoAdmissionNo
 * Returns format: ADM-[YEAR]-[CLASS]-[ROLL]
 */
export function formatAutoAdmissionNo(
  academicYearId: string,
  classId: string,
  rollNumber: number
): string {
  const cleanYear = (academicYearId || '').toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '')
  const cleanClass = (classId || '').toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '')
  const padRoll = String(rollNumber).padStart(rollNumber < 100 ? 2 : 3, '0')
  return `ADM-${cleanYear}-${cleanClass}-${padRoll}`
}

/**

export function validateParsedRoster(

  const rollCounts = new Map<number, number>()

  rows.forEach((r) => {

      nextAvailableRoll++

import { getPgPool } from '@/lib/db'

export const SLOT_ORDER = ['t1', 't2', 't3', 't4', 't5', 't6', 't7', 't8', 't9', 't10']

export function getSlotRange(startSlotId?: string | null, span: number = 1): { start: number; end: number } {
  if (!startSlotId) return { start: 0, end: Math.max(0, span - 1) }
  const cleanId = startSlotId.toLowerCase()
  const startIdx = SLOT_ORDER.indexOf(cleanId)
  const safeStart = startIdx === -1 ? 0 : startIdx
  return {
    start: safeStart,
    end: safeStart + Math.max(1, span || 1) - 1,
  }
}

export function slotRangesOverlap(
  r1: { start: number; end: number },
  r2: { start: number; end: number }
): boolean {
  return r1.start <= r2.end && r1.end >= r2.start
}

export function timeRangesOverlap(
  start1?: string | null,
  end1?: string | null,
  start2?: string | null,
  end2?: string | null
): boolean {
  if (!start1 || !end1 || !start2 || !end2) return true
  // Format HH:MM string comparison
  return start1 < end2 && end1 > start2
}

export interface CheckSchedulingConflictParams {
  labId: string
  secondaryLabId?: string | null
  teacherId?: string | null
  teacherName?: string | null
  classSubjectId?: string | null
  classId?: string | null
  batchName?: string | null
  dayKey: string
  slotId?: string | null
  span?: number
  startTime?: string | null
  endTime?: string | null
  excludeScheduleId?: string | null
}

export interface ConflictDetail {
  type: 'room' | 'faculty' | 'cohort' | 'lab_status'
  message: string
  conflictingSchedule?: {
    id: string
    subject_name: string
    batch_name: string
    lab_id: string
    slot_id: string
    start_time: string
    end_time: string
    teacher_name?: string
  }
}

export interface ConflictCheckResult {
  hasConflict: boolean
  conflictType: 'none' | 'room' | 'faculty' | 'cohort' | 'lab_status'
  message: string | null
  conflicts: ConflictDetail[]
}

/**
 * Institutional Triple-Collision Defense Engine
 * Evaluates Room, Faculty, and Cohort double-booking across weekly academic timetable slots.
 */
export async function checkSchedulingConflicts(
  params: CheckSchedulingConflictParams
): Promise<ConflictCheckResult> {
  const pool = getPgPool()
  const conflicts: ConflictDetail[] = []

  // 1. Verify Target Lab Operational Status
  const labRes = await pool.query(
    `SELECT id, name, status, is_active FROM public.labs WHERE id = $1`,
    [params.labId]
  )
  if (labRes.rows.length > 0) {
    const lab = labRes.rows[0]
    if (lab.status === 'Under Maintenance') {
      const msg = `Booking Rejected: "${lab.name || params.labId}" is currently Under Maintenance and cannot be booked for practical sessions.`
      return {
        hasConflict: true,
        conflictType: 'lab_status',
        message: msg,
        conflicts: [{ type: 'lab_status', message: msg }],
      }
    }
    if (!lab.is_active || lab.status === 'Inactive') {
      const msg = `Booking Rejected: "${lab.name || params.labId}" is currently Inactive / Decommissioned.`
      return {
        hasConflict: true,
        conflictType: 'lab_status',
        message: msg,
        conflicts: [{ type: 'lab_status', message: msg }],
      }
    }
  }

  // 2. Resolve Target Class ID if classSubjectId is provided
  let targetClassId = params.classId || null
  let resolvedTeacherId = params.teacherId || null

  if (params.classSubjectId) {
    const csRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT class_id, teacher_id FROM public.class_subjects WHERE id = $1`,
      [params.classSubjectId]
    )
    if (csRes.rows.length > 0) {
      if (!targetClassId) targetClassId = csRes.rows[0].class_id
      if (!resolvedTeacherId) resolvedTeacherId = csRes.rows[0].teacher_id
    }
  }

  // 3. Query all active schedules for the specified day of week
  const schedRes = await pool.query(
    `SELECT 
       s.id,
       s.lab_id,
       s.teacher_id,
       s.subject_name,
       s.batch_name,
       s.slot_id,
       s.span,
       s.start_time,
       s.end_time,
       s.metadata,
       s.class_subject_id,
       cs.class_id
     FROM public.schedules s
     LEFT JOIN public.class_subjects cs ON cs.id = s.class_subject_id
     WHERE LOWER(s.day_key) = LOWER($1)
       AND s.status != 'cancelled'`,
    [params.dayKey]
  )

  const targetRange = getSlotRange(params.slotId, params.span || 1)
  const norm = (s?: string | null) => (s ? s.trim().toLowerCase() : '')

  for (const existing of schedRes.rows) {
    if (params.excludeScheduleId && existing.id === params.excludeScheduleId) {
      continue
    }

    const existRange = getSlotRange(existing.slot_id || 't1', existing.span || 1)
    const slotOverlaps = slotRangesOverlap(targetRange, existRange)
    const timeOverlaps = timeRangesOverlap(
      params.startTime,
      params.endTime,
      existing.start_time,
      existing.end_time
    )

    // Consider overlapping if either slot range or custom time window collides
    const hasOverlap = params.slotId && existing.slot_id ? slotOverlaps : timeOverlaps

    if (!hasOverlap) {
      continue
    }

    const existSecLabId = existing.metadata?.secondary_lab_id || existing.metadata?.secondaryLabKey
    const conflictScheduleSummary = {
      id: existing.id,
      subject_name: existing.subject_name,
      batch_name: existing.batch_name,
      lab_id: existing.lab_id,
      slot_id: existing.slot_id,
      start_time: existing.start_time,
      end_time: existing.end_time,
      teacher_name: existing.metadata?.teacher,
    }

    // A. Room / Facility Collision
    const primaryCollides = existing.lab_id === params.labId || existSecLabId === params.labId
    const secondaryCollides =
      params.secondaryLabId &&
      (existing.lab_id === params.secondaryLabId || existSecLabId === params.secondaryLabId)

    if (primaryCollides || secondaryCollides) {
      const conflictingLab = primaryCollides ? params.labId : params.secondaryLabId
      const msg = `Facility Collision: Laboratory (${conflictingLab}) is already reserved for "${existing.subject_name}" (${existing.batch_name}) during Period ${existing.slot_id?.toUpperCase() || ''}.`
      conflicts.push({
        type: 'room',
        message: msg,
        conflictingSchedule: conflictScheduleSummary,
      })
    }

    // B. Faculty Collision (Assigned Teacher double-booked)
    const sameTeacherId =
      resolvedTeacherId && existing.teacher_id && resolvedTeacherId === existing.teacher_id
    const reqTeacherName = norm(params.teacherName)
    const existTeacherName = norm(existing.metadata?.teacher)
    const sameTeacherName = reqTeacherName && existTeacherName && reqTeacherName === existTeacherName

    if (sameTeacherId || sameTeacherName) {
      const teacherDisplay = params.teacherName || 'The assigned teacher'
      const msg = `Faculty Collision: ${teacherDisplay} is already conducting "${existing.subject_name}" in another laboratory during this period.`
      conflicts.push({
        type: 'faculty',
        message: msg,
        conflictingSchedule: conflictScheduleSummary,
      })
    }

    // C. Cohort Collision (Student batch double-booked)
    const existClassId = existing.class_id
    const sameClassId = targetClassId && existClassId && targetClassId === existClassId
    const normReqBatch = norm(params.batchName)
    const normExistBatch = norm(existing.batch_name)
    const sameBatchName =
      normReqBatch &&
      normExistBatch &&
      (normReqBatch === normExistBatch ||
        (normReqBatch.length > 5 && normExistBatch === normReqBatch))

    if (sameClassId || (sameBatchName && !sameClassId)) {
      const batchDisplay = params.batchName || 'Student cohort'
      const msg = `Class Batch Collision: Student cohort "${batchDisplay}" is already scheduled for "${existing.subject_name}" in another lab during this period.`
      conflicts.push({
        type: 'cohort',
        message: msg,
        conflictingSchedule: conflictScheduleSummary,
      })
    }
  }

  if (conflicts.length > 0) {
    const primaryConflict = conflicts[0]
    return {
      hasConflict: true,
      conflictType: primaryConflict.type,
      message: primaryConflict.message,
      conflicts,
    }
  }

  return {
    hasConflict: false,
    conflictType: 'none',
    message: null,
    conflicts: [],
  }
}

import crypto from 'node:crypto'

/**
 * Institutional Terminal Token & Session Security Engine.
 * Provides HMAC-SHA256 stateless signing for 1-time handshake tickets
 * and HttpOnly workstation session cookies.
 */

const SECRET_KEY =
  process.env.TERMINAL_SIGNING_SECRET ||
  process.env.SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET ||
  process.env.NEXTAUTH_SECRET ||
  'labsync-lims-default-terminal-signing-salt-2083'

export interface HandshakeTicketPayload {
  stationId: string
  stationCode: string
  machineGuid: string
  iat: number // issued-at timestamp in milliseconds
  exp: number // expiration timestamp in milliseconds
}

export interface TerminalSessionPayload {
  stationId: string
  stationCode: string
  machineGuid: string
  issuedAt: number
}

function base64UrlEncode(str: string): string {
  return Buffer.from(str, 'utf8')
    .toString('base64')
    .replace(/\+/g, '-')
    .replace(/\//g, '_')
    .replace(/=+$/, '')
}

function base64UrlDecode(str: string): string {
  let base64 = str.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/')
  while (base64.length % 4) {
    base64 += '='
  }
  return Buffer.from(base64, 'base64').toString('utf8')
}

function sign(payloadStr: string): string {
  return crypto
    .createHmac('sha256', SECRET_KEY)
    .update(payloadStr)
    .digest('base64')
    .replace(/\+/g, '-')
    .replace(/\//g, '_')
    .replace(/=+$/, '')
}

/**
 * Creates a stateless 60-second single-use handshake ticket.
 */
export function createHandshakeTicket(
  workstation: {
    id: string
    label: string
    machine_guid: string
  },
  ttlSeconds: number = 60
): string {
  const now = Date.now()
  const payload: HandshakeTicketPayload = {
    stationId: workstation.id,
    stationCode: workstation.label,
    machineGuid: workstation.machine_guid,
    iat: now,
    exp: now + ttlSeconds * 1000, // configurable single-use window (default 60s)
  }

  const encodedPayload = base64UrlEncode(JSON.stringify(payload))
  const signature = sign(encodedPayload)
  return `${encodedPayload}.${signature}`
}

// Anti-replay cache: tracks redeemed ticket signatures for their 60s window
const REDEEMED_TICKETS = new Map<string, number>()

function pruneExpiredRedeemedTickets() {
  const now = Date.now()
  for (const [sig, exp] of REDEEMED_TICKETS.entries()) {
    if (now > exp) {
      REDEEMED_TICKETS.delete(sig)
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Verifies a 60-second handshake ticket.
 * Enforces HMAC timing-safe validation, expiration check, and anti-replay defense.
 */
export function verifyHandshakeTicket(ticket: string): {
  valid: boolean
  payload?: HandshakeTicketPayload
  reason?: string
} {
  if (!ticket || !ticket.includes('.')) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'Malformed ticket format' }
  }

  const [encodedPayload, receivedSignature] = ticket.split('.')
  if (!encodedPayload || !receivedSignature) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'Missing payload or signature' }
  }

  const expectedSignature = sign(encodedPayload)

  // Timing-safe signature comparison
  const receivedBuf = Buffer.from(receivedSignature)
  const expectedBuf = Buffer.from(expectedSignature)

  if (
    receivedBuf.length !== expectedBuf.length ||
    !crypto.timingSafeEqual(receivedBuf, expectedBuf)
  ) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'Invalid cryptographic signature' }
  }

  // Anti-replay check: ensure ticket has not already been redeemed
  pruneExpiredRedeemedTickets()
  if (REDEEMED_TICKETS.has(receivedSignature)) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'Single-use handshake ticket has already been redeemed' }
  }

  try {
    const jsonStr = base64UrlDecode(encodedPayload)
    const payload: HandshakeTicketPayload = JSON.parse(jsonStr)

    // Check expiration
    if (Date.now() > payload.exp) {
      return { valid: false, reason: 'Handshake ticket has expired (valid for 60s)' }
    }

    // Mark ticket as redeemed
    REDEEMED_TICKETS.set(receivedSignature, payload.exp)

    return { valid: true, payload }
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { valid: false, reason: `Failed to decode payload: ${err.message}` }
  }
}

/**
 * Creates a signed HttpOnly session token representing the physical workstation.
 */
export function createTerminalSessionToken(workstation: {
  id: string
  label: string
  machine_guid: string
}): string {
  const payload: TerminalSessionPayload = {
    stationId: workstation.id,
    stationCode: workstation.label,
    machineGuid: workstation.machine_guid,
    issuedAt: Date.now(),
  }

  const encodedPayload = base64UrlEncode(JSON.stringify(payload))
  const signature = sign(encodedPayload)
  return `${encodedPayload}.${signature}`
}

/**
 * Verifies a workstation session token extracted from HttpOnly cookie.
 */
export function verifyTerminalSessionToken(token: string): {
  valid: boolean
  payload?: TerminalSessionPayload
  reason?: string
} {
  if (!token || !token.includes('.')) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'Malformed session token' }
  }

  const [encodedPayload, receivedSignature] = token.split('.')
  if (!encodedPayload || !receivedSignature) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'Missing payload or signature' }
  }

  const expectedSignature = sign(encodedPayload)
  const receivedBuf = Buffer.from(receivedSignature)
  const expectedBuf = Buffer.from(expectedSignature)

  if (
    receivedBuf.length !== expectedBuf.length ||
    !crypto.timingSafeEqual(receivedBuf, expectedBuf)
  ) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'Invalid session signature' }
  }

  try {
    const jsonStr = base64UrlDecode(encodedPayload)
    const payload: TerminalSessionPayload = JSON.parse(jsonStr)
    return { valid: true, payload }
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { valid: false, reason: `Failed to decode session payload: ${err.message}` }
  }
}

/**
 * Timing-safe string comparison for composite hardware GUIDs.
 */
export function safeEqual(a: string, b: string): boolean {
  if (typeof a !== 'string' || typeof b !== 'string') return false
  const bufA = Buffer.from(a)
  const bufB = Buffer.from(b)
  if (bufA.length !== bufB.length) return false
  return crypto.timingSafeEqual(bufA, bufB)
}

/**
 * Client-side auto-crop & compression pipeline for student avatars.
 * Center-crops to 1:1 square, clamps to 256x256, and outputs lightweight base64 Data URL (~15-25 KB).
 */

export interface CompressedAvatarResult {
  dataUrl: string
  sizeBytes: number
  width: number
  height: number
}

export async function compressStudentAvatar(
  file: File | Blob,
  targetSize = 256,
  quality = 0.75
): Promise<CompressedAvatarResult> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    // If not running in a browser environment, reject safely
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof document === 'undefined') {
      return reject(new Error('compressStudentAvatar must be executed in a browser environment.'))
    }

    const reader = new FileReader()
    reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to read photo file.'))
    reader.onload = (e) => {
      const img = new Image()
      img.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to decode image.'))
      img.onload = () => {
        try {
          const canvas = document.createElement('canvas')
          canvas.width = targetSize
          canvas.height = targetSize
          const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')

          if (!ctx) {
            return reject(new Error('Failed to get 2D canvas context.'))
          }

          // Calculate center square crop coordinates
          const srcWidth = img.naturalWidth || img.width
          const srcHeight = img.naturalHeight || img.height
          const minDim = Math.min(srcWidth, srcHeight)

          const srcX = (srcWidth - minDim) / 2
          const srcY = (srcHeight - minDim) / 2

          // Smooth rendering
          ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true
          ctx.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high'

          // Draw center-cropped square resized to targetSize
          ctx.drawImage(img, srcX, srcY, minDim, minDim, 0, 0, targetSize, targetSize)

          // Encode to JPEG data URL
          const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality)
          // Estimate byte size from base64 string
          const base64Length = dataUrl.length - (dataUrl.indexOf(',') + 1)
          const sizeBytes = Math.round((base64Length * 3) / 4)

          resolve({
            dataUrl,
            sizeBytes,
            width: targetSize,
            height: targetSize,
          })
        } catch (err) {
          reject(err)
        }
      }
      img.src = e.target?.result as string
    }

    reader.readAsDataURL(file)
  })
}

/** Alias for general user/staff profile avatar compression */
export const compressAvatar = compressStudentAvatar

/**
 * Deterministic Two-Factor Student Photo Matcher.
 * Matches filenames such as "8_kaustuv_thapa.jpg", "08-kaustuv-thapa.png",
 * "14_aarav_sharma.jpeg", "8.jpg", or "ADM-042.jpg" against active class roster records.
 */

export interface StudentPhotoCandidate {
  student_id: string
  full_name: string
  roll_number: number
  admission_no: string | null
  registration_no: string | null
  photo_url?: string | null
}

export type PhotoMatchConfidence = 'high' | 'medium' | 'unmatched'

export interface ParsedPhotoFilename {
  rawFilename: string
  basename: string
  extension: string
  extractedRoll: number | null
  extractedNameCandidate: string | null
}

export interface MatchedStudentPhoto {
  file: File
  filename: string
  previewUrl: string
  dataUrl?: string
  extractedRoll: number | null
  extractedName: string | null
  matchedStudentId: string | null
  matchedStudentName: string | null
  matchedRollNumber: number | null
  confidence: PhotoMatchConfidence
  matchReason: string
}

/**
 * Normalizes a name string for fuzzy token comparison.
 * "kaustuv_thapa" -> ["kaustuv", "thapa"]
 * "Aarav Sharma (Sci)" -> ["aarav", "sharma", "sci"]
 */
export function tokenizeName(name: string): string[] {
  return name
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[._\-+,/()]/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim()
    .split(' ')
    .filter(Boolean)
}

/**
 * Checks if two names have significant token overlap or fuzzy similarity.
 */
export function doNamesMatch(nameA: string, nameB: string): boolean {
  const tokensA = tokenizeName(nameA)
  const tokensB = tokenizeName(nameB)
  if (tokensA.length === 0 || tokensB.length === 0) return false

  // Exact token match
  const common = tokensA.filter((t) => tokensB.includes(t))
  if (common.length >= 1 && (common.some((t) => t.length >= 3) || common.length >= Math.min(tokensA.length, tokensB.length))) {
    return true
  }

  // 1-character typo tolerance on tokens of length >= 4 (e.g. kaustuv vs kaustav)
  for (const a of tokensA) {
    for (const b of tokensB) {
      if (a === b) return true
      if (a.length >= 4 && b.length >= 4 && Math.abs(a.length - b.length) <= 1) {
        let diffs = 0
        for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(a.length, b.length); i++) {
          if (a[i] !== b[i]) diffs++
        }
        if (diffs <= 1) return true
      }
    }
  }

  return false
}

/**
 * Parses raw photo filename into roll and name candidates.
 * Supports:
 * - "8_kaustuv_thapa.jpg"
 * - "08-kaustuv-thapa.png"
 * - "14 aarav sharma.jpeg"
 * - "8.jpg", "roll-8.jpg"
 * - "kaustuv_thapa.jpg"
 */
export function parsePhotoFilename(filename: string): ParsedPhotoFilename {
  const lastDot = filename.lastIndexOf('.')
  const basename = lastDot !== -1 ? filename.slice(0, lastDot) : filename
  const extension = lastDot !== -1 ? filename.slice(lastDot + 1).toLowerCase() : ''

  // Pattern 1: Leading roll followed by separator and name: "8_kaustuv_thapa", "08-kaustuv-thapa", "14 aarav sharma"
  const rollAndNameMatch = basename.match(/^(\d+)[\s_\-]+(.+)$/)
  if (rollAndNameMatch) {
    const roll = parseInt(rollAndNameMatch[1], 10)
    const namePart = rollAndNameMatch[2].replace(/[_\-]+/g, ' ').trim()
    return {
      rawFilename: filename,
      basename,
      extension,
      extractedRoll: Number.isFinite(roll) ? roll : null,
      extractedNameCandidate: namePart || null,
    }
  }

  // Pattern 2: Roll number only: "8", "08", "roll-8", "roll_08"
  const rollOnlyMatch = basename.match(/^(?:roll[\s_\-]*)?(\d+)$/i)
  if (rollOnlyMatch) {
    const roll = parseInt(rollOnlyMatch[1], 10)
    return {
      rawFilename: filename,
      basename,
      extension,
      extractedRoll: Number.isFinite(roll) ? roll : null,
      extractedNameCandidate: null,
    }
  }

  // Pattern 3: Name only or alphanumeric ID (e.g. "kaustuv_thapa" or "ADM-042")
  return {
    rawFilename: filename,
    basename,
    extension,
    extractedRoll: null,
    extractedNameCandidate: basename.replace(/[_\-]+/g, ' ').trim(),
  }
}

/**
 * Matches a list of photo files against a class roster using the deterministic 2-factor ladder.
 */
export function matchPhotosToStudents(
  files: File[],
  students: StudentPhotoCandidate[]
): MatchedStudentPhoto[] {
  // Index students by roll number
  const rollMap = new Map<number, StudentPhotoCandidate>()
  // Index students by normalized admission/registration number
  const idMap = new Map<string, StudentPhotoCandidate>()

  for (const s of students) {
    rollMap.set(s.roll_number, s)
    if (s.admission_no) idMap.set(s.admission_no.toLowerCase().trim(), s)
    if (s.registration_no) idMap.set(s.registration_no.toLowerCase().trim(), s)
  }

  return files.map((file) => {
    const parsed = parsePhotoFilename(file.name)
    let previewUrl = ''
    try {
      if (typeof URL !== 'undefined' && typeof URL.createObjectURL === 'function' && typeof Blob !== 'undefined' && file instanceof Blob) {
        previewUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file)
      }
    } catch {
      previewUrl = ''
    }

    // Strategy 1: Check exact institutional ID match (e.g. "ADM-2083-014.jpg" or "1641052469.jpg")
    const cleanedBase = parsed.basename.toLowerCase().trim()
    const studentById = idMap.get(cleanedBase)
    if (studentById) {
      return {
        file,
        filename: file.name,
        previewUrl,
        extractedRoll: parsed.extractedRoll,
        extractedName: parsed.extractedNameCandidate,
        matchedStudentId: studentById.student_id,
        matchedStudentName: studentById.full_name,
        matchedRollNumber: studentById.roll_number,
        confidence: 'high',
        matchReason: `âœ“ Matched by Institutional ID (${studentById.admission_no || studentById.registration_no})`,
      }
    }

    // Strategy 2: Two-Factor Roll + Name Ladder
    if (parsed.extractedRoll !== null) {
      const studentByRoll = rollMap.get(parsed.extractedRoll)

      if (studentByRoll) {
        // If we also extracted a candidate name, cross-verify
        if (parsed.extractedNameCandidate) {
          const namesMatch = doNamesMatch(parsed.extractedNameCandidate, studentByRoll.full_name)
          if (namesMatch) {
            return {
              file,
              filename: file.name,
              previewUrl,
              extractedRoll: parsed.extractedRoll,
              extractedName: parsed.extractedNameCandidate,
              matchedStudentId: studentByRoll.student_id,
              matchedStudentName: studentByRoll.full_name,
              matchedRollNumber: studentByRoll.roll_number,
              confidence: 'high',
              matchReason: `âœ“ Matched (Roll ${studentByRoll.roll_number} + Name Verified)`,
            }
          } else {
            // Roll matched, but name differed (possible roll shift or typo)
            return {
              file,
              filename: file.name,
              previewUrl,
              extractedRoll: parsed.extractedRoll,
              extractedName: parsed.extractedNameCandidate,
              matchedStudentId: studentByRoll.student_id,
              matchedStudentName: studentByRoll.full_name,
              matchedRollNumber: studentByRoll.roll_number,
              confidence: 'medium',
              matchReason: `Roll ${studentByRoll.roll_number} matched, but name differs ("${parsed.extractedNameCandidate}")`,
            }
          }
        }

        // Just roll number provided (e.g. "8.jpg")
        return {
          file,
          filename: file.name,
          previewUrl,
          extractedRoll: parsed.extractedRoll,
          extractedName: null,
          matchedStudentId: studentByRoll.student_id,
          matchedStudentName: studentByRoll.full_name,
          matchedRollNumber: studentByRoll.roll_number,
          confidence: 'high',
          matchReason: `âœ“ Matched by Roll Number (${studentByRoll.roll_number})`,
        }
      }
    }

    // Strategy 3: Name-only matching if roll was absent or not found in class
    if (parsed.extractedNameCandidate) {
      const candidates = students.filter((s) =>
        doNamesMatch(parsed.extractedNameCandidate!, s.full_name)
      )

      if (candidates.length === 1) {
        const student = candidates[0]
        return {
          file,
          filename: file.name,
          previewUrl,
          extractedRoll: parsed.extractedRoll,
          extractedName: parsed.extractedNameCandidate,
          matchedStudentId: student.student_id,
          matchedStudentName: student.full_name,
          matchedRollNumber: student.roll_number,
          confidence: 'medium',
          matchReason: `Matched by Student Name (Current Roll: ${student.roll_number})`,
        }
      }
    }

    // Fallback: Unmatched
    return {
      file,
      filename: file.name,
      previewUrl,
      extractedRoll: parsed.extractedRoll,
      extractedName: parsed.extractedNameCandidate,
      matchedStudentId: null,
      matchedStudentName: null,
      matchedRollNumber: null,
      confidence: 'unmatched',
      matchReason: 'Unmatched file â€” select student manually from dropdown',
    }
  })
}

import { createServerClient, type CookieOptions } from '@supabase/ssr'
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server'

export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {
  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({
    request: {
      headers: request.headers,
    },
  })

  const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
  const supabaseAnonKey = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY

  if (!supabaseUrl || !supabaseAnonKey || supabaseUrl.includes('dummy-project')) {
    return supabaseResponse
  }

  try {
    const supabase = createServerClient(
      supabaseUrl,
      supabaseAnonKey,
      {
        cookies: {
          get(name: string) {
            return request.cookies.get(name)?.value
          },
          set(name: string, value: string, options: CookieOptions) {
            request.cookies.set({
              name,
              value,
              ...options,
            })
            supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({
              request: {
                headers: request.headers,
              },
            })
            supabaseResponse.cookies.set({
              name,
              value,
              ...options,
            })
          },
          remove(name: string, options: CookieOptions) {
            request.cookies.set({
              name,
              value: '',
              ...options,
            })
            supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({
              request: {
                headers: request.headers,
              },
            })
            supabaseResponse.cookies.set({
              name,
              value: '',
              ...options,
            })
          },
        },
      }
    )

    await supabase.auth.getUser()
  } catch (error) {
    // Graceful fallback for unconfigured environments
  }

  return supabaseResponse
}

import { createServerClient } from '@supabase/ssr'
import { cookies } from 'next/headers'
import type { Database } from '@/types/database'

export async function createClient() {
  let cookieStore: any = null
  try {
    cookieStore = await cookies()
  } catch {
    // Called outside request scope (e.g. CLI script or background task)
  }

  return createServerClient<Database>(
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
    {
      cookies: {
        getAll() {
          return cookieStore ? cookieStore.getAll() : []
        },
        setAll(cookiesToSet) {
          if (!cookieStore) return
          try {
            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
              cookieStore.set(name, value, options)
            )
          } catch (error) {
            // The `setAll` method was called from a Server Component.
            // This can be ignored if you have middleware refreshing user sessions.
          }
        },
      },
    }
  )
}

/**
 * Types & Domain Helpers for Fleet Maintenance Operations
 * Used across /maintenance, /computer-lab, and Server Actions.
 */

export type FleetTerminalStatus = 'pending' | 'completed' | 'blocked'

export interface FleetTerminalEntry {
  status: FleetTerminalStatus
  updated_at: string
  technician_name?: string
  technician_id?: string
  notes?: string
}

export type FleetProgressMap = Record<string, FleetTerminalEntry>

export interface FleetProgressSummary {
  total: number
  completed: number
  pending: number
  blocked: number
  percentage: number
}

/**
 * Pure calculation helper: computes summary metrics from machine list and progress map
 */
export function calculateFleetProgressSummary(
  targetMachines: string[],
  progress: FleetProgressMap | null | undefined
): FleetProgressSummary {
  const total = targetMachines.length
  if (total === 0) {
    return {
      total: 0,
      completed: 0,
      pending: 0,
      blocked: 0,
      percentage: 0,
    }
  }

  let completed = 0
  let blocked = 0
  let pending = 0

  const safeMap = progress || {}

  for (const label of targetMachines) {
    const entry = safeMap[label]
    if (!entry || entry.status === 'pending') {
      pending++
    } else if (entry.status === 'completed') {
      completed++
    } else if (entry.status === 'blocked') {
      blocked++
    } else {
      pending++
    }
  }

  const percentage = Math.round((completed / total) * 100)

  return {
    total,
    completed,
    pending,
    blocked,
    percentage,
  }
}

/**
 * Natural sort for workstation labels (PC-01 before PC-10, Teacher Pod at the end or top)
 */
export function sortWorkstationLabels(labels: string[]): string[] {
  return [...labels].sort((a, b) => {
    const aIsTeacher = a.toLowerCase().includes('teacher') || a.toLowerCase().includes('podium')
    const bIsTeacher = b.toLowerCase().includes('teacher') || b.toLowerCase().includes('podium')
    if (aIsTeacher && !bIsTeacher) return 1
    if (!aIsTeacher && bIsTeacher) return -1

    return a.localeCompare(b, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' })
  })
}

/**
 * Group workstation labels by Row (Row A, Row B, etc. or chunks of 10)
 */
export function groupWorkstationLabelsByRow(labels: string[]): Array<{
  rowLabel: string
  items: string[]
}> {
  const sorted = sortWorkstationLabels(labels)
  const map: Map<string, string[]> = new Map()

  for (const label of sorted) {
    // If label starts with PC- and we want to group by chunks or known pattern
    const lower = label.toLowerCase()
    let group = 'Fleet'
    if (lower.includes('teacher') || lower.includes('podium')) {
      group = 'Teacher Pod'
    } else {
      // Check if standard PC-XX number
      const numMatch = label.match(/\d+/)
      if (numMatch) {
        const num = parseInt(numMatch[0], 10)
        if (num <= 10) group = 'Row A (01-10)'
        else if (num <= 20) group = 'Row B (11-20)'
        else if (num <= 30) group = 'Row C (21-30)'
        else if (num <= 40) group = 'Row D (31-40)'
        else if (num <= 50) group = 'Row E (41-50)'
        else group = 'Additional Stations'
      }
    }

    if (!map.has(group)) {
      map.set(group, [])
    }
    map.get(group)!.push(label)
  }

  return Array.from(map.entries()).map(([rowLabel, items]) => ({
    rowLabel,
    items,
  }))
}

/**
 * Snaps a coordinate percentage to the nearest grid increment (e.g. 1%, 2%, 4%).
 */
export function snapCoordinate(val: number, snapGrid: number = 2): number {
  if (snapGrid <= 0) return Math.round(val * 10) / 10
  const snapped = Math.round(val / snapGrid) * snapGrid
  return Math.max(2, Math.min(98, Math.round(snapped * 10) / 10))
}

/**
 * Sort workstations naturally by label (PC-01, PC-02, ..., PC-10, Teacher-01 at front)
 */
export function sortWorkstationsByLabel<T extends { label: string }>(items: T[]): {
  teacherNodes: T[]
  studentNodes: T[]
} {
  const teacherNodes: T[] = []
  const studentNodes: T[] = []

  for (const item of items) {
    const lbl = item.label.toLowerCase()
    if (lbl.includes('teacher') || lbl.includes('podium') || lbl.includes('instructor')) {
      teacherNodes.push(item)
    } else {
      studentNodes.push(item)
    }
  }

  // Natural numeric sort for student PCs (PC-01, PC-2, PC-10)
  studentNodes.sort((a, b) => {
    const numA = parseInt(a.label.replace(/\D/g, '') || '0', 10)
    const numB = parseInt(b.label.replace(/\D/g, '') || '0', 10)
    if (numA !== numB) return numA - numB
    return a.label.localeCompare(b.label)
  })

  return { teacherNodes, studentNodes }
}

/**
 * Mathematically generates new workstation coordinates based on the selected layout preset.
 */
export function calculateAutoArrangement<
  T extends { id: string; label: string; row_label?: string | null; position_id?: string | null }
>(
  workstations: T[],
  preset: LayoutPresetType = 'official_dual_wing',
  snapGrid: number = 2
): WorkstationPositionUpdate[] {
  const { teacherNodes, studentNodes } = sortWorkstationsByLabel(workstations)
  const results: WorkstationPositionUpdate[] = []

  // 1. Position Teacher Podium(s)
  teacherNodes.forEach((node, idx) => {
    const posX = snapCoordinate(50 + (idx - (teacherNodes.length - 1) / 2) * 15, snapGrid)
    const posY = snapCoordinate(12, snapGrid)
    results.push({
      id: node.id,
      label: node.label,
      pos_x: posX,
      pos_y: posY,
      row_label: 'Teacher Podium',
      position_id: 'PODIUM',
    })
  })

  const N = studentNodes.length
  if (N === 0) return results

  if (preset === 'official_dual_wing') {
    const slots = generateRoomGridSlots(
      {
        sides: 2,
        rows: 6,
        columns: 4,
        rowNaming: 'letters',
        terminalNaming: 'preserve',
      },
      snapGrid
    )

    // Map canonical slots by slot index (1 to 48) and positionId (e.g. A1, C2)
    const slotByNumber = new Map<number, (typeof slots)[0]>()
    const slotByPosId = new Map<string, (typeof slots)[0]>()
    slots.forEach((s) => {
      slotByNumber.set(s.slotIndex + 1, s)
      slotByPosId.set(s.positionId.toUpperCase(), s)
    })

    const unassignedNodes: typeof studentNodes = []
    const occupiedSlotIndices = new Set<number>()

    // Place each PC directly at its corresponding canonical desk number (PC-N -> Slot N)
    // Missing/deleted PCs naturally leave their canonical slot completely empty!
    studentNodes.forEach((node) => {
      const numMatch = node.label.match(/\d+/)
      const pcNum = numMatch ? parseInt(numMatch[0], 10) : null

      let matchedSlot: (typeof slots)[0] | undefined

      if (pcNum && slotByNumber.has(pcNum) && !occupiedSlotIndices.has(pcNum)) {
        matchedSlot = slotByNumber.get(pcNum)
      } else if (
        node.position_id &&
        slotByPosId.has(String(node.position_id).toUpperCase()) &&
        !occupiedSlotIndices.has(slotByPosId.get(String(node.position_id).toUpperCase())!.slotIndex + 1)
      ) {
        matchedSlot = slotByPosId.get(String(node.position_id).toUpperCase())
      }

      if (matchedSlot) {
        occupiedSlotIndices.add(matchedSlot.slotIndex + 1)
        results.push({
          id: node.id,
          label: node.label,
          pos_x: matchedSlot.pos_x,
          pos_y: matchedSlot.pos_y,
          row_label: matchedSlot.rowLabel,
          position_id: matchedSlot.positionId,
        })
      } else {
        unassignedNodes.push(node)
      }
    })

    // For extra or out-of-range PCs (> 48 or unnumbered, e.g. PC-490):
    // NEVER put them into empty canonical 1..48 slots! They belong in extension positions aligned with columns.
    unassignedNodes.forEach((node, extraIdx) => {
      const extCol = extraIdx % 4
      const extSide = Math.floor(extraIdx / 4) % 2 // 0: left wing, 1: right wing
      const extRowIdx = Math.floor(extraIdx / 8)
      const xStart = extSide === 0 ? 6 : 58
      const xStep = 12
      const extX = snapCoordinate(xStart + extCol * xStep, snapGrid)
      const extY = snapCoordinate(100 + extRowIdx * 12, snapGrid)
      const rowName = `Row ${String.fromCharCode(77 + extRowIdx)} (Extension)`
      const posId = `EXT-${extraIdx + 1}`

      results.push({
        id: node.id,
        label: node.label,
        pos_x: extX,
        pos_y: extY,
        row_label: rowName,
        position_id: posId,
      })
    })

    return results
  }

  if (preset.startsWith('rows_')) {
    // Dynamic row preset parser: rows_2x8, rows_3x8, rows_4x8, rows_5x10, rows_6x8
    const match = preset.match(/^rows_(\d+)x(\d+)$/)
    const rowCount = match ? parseInt(match[1], 10) : 4
    const itemsPerRow = Math.ceil(N / rowCount)
    const rowYStart = rowCount > 4 ? 26 : 30
    const rowYEnd = rowCount > 4 ? 90 : 86
    const rowYStep = rowCount > 1 ? (rowYEnd - rowYStart) / (rowCount - 1) : 0
    const rowNames = Array.from({ length: rowCount }, (_, i) => `Row ${String.fromCharCode(65 + i)}`)

    studentNodes.forEach((node, idx) => {
      const rowIndex = Math.min(rowCount - 1, Math.floor(idx / itemsPerRow))
      const colIndex = idx % itemsPerRow
      const countInThisRow = Math.min(itemsPerRow, N - rowIndex * itemsPerRow)

      const xMargin = rowCount >= 5 ? 8 : 12
      const xSpan = 100 - xMargin * 2
      const xStep = countInThisRow > 1 ? xSpan / (countInThisRow - 1) : 0
      const posX = countInThisRow > 1 ? xMargin + colIndex * xStep : 50
      const posY = rowCount > 1 ? rowYStart + rowIndex * rowYStep : 58

      results.push({
        id: node.id,
        label: node.label,
        pos_x: snapCoordinate(posX, snapGrid),
        pos_y: snapCoordinate(posY, snapGrid),
        row_label: rowNames[rowIndex] || `Row ${rowIndex + 1}`,
      })
    })
  } else if (preset === 'dual_islands') {
    // Dual Islands: Left Pod and Right Pod with central walking aisle
    const rowCount = Math.max(3, Math.ceil(N / 8))
    const halfCount = Math.ceil(N / 2)
    const rowYStart = 28
    const rowYEnd = 88
    const rowYStep = (rowYEnd - rowYStart) / Math.max(1, rowCount - 1)

    studentNodes.forEach((node, idx) => {
      const isLeft = idx < halfCount
      const islandIndex = isLeft ? idx : idx - halfCount
      const islandTotal = isLeft ? halfCount : N - halfCount
      const colsPerIsland = Math.ceil(islandTotal / rowCount)

      const rowIndex = Math.min(rowCount - 1, Math.floor(islandIndex / colsPerIsland))
      const colIndex = islandIndex % colsPerIsland

      const xStart = isLeft ? 8 : 62
      const xEnd = isLeft ? 38 : 92
      const xStep = colsPerIsland > 1 ? (xEnd - xStart) / (colsPerIsland - 1) : 0
      const posX = colsPerIsland > 1 ? xStart + colIndex * xStep : (xStart + xEnd) / 2
      const posY = rowYStart + rowIndex * rowYStep

      results.push({
        id: node.id,
        label: node.label,
        pos_x: snapCoordinate(posX, snapGrid),
        pos_y: snapCoordinate(posY, snapGrid),
        row_label: `${isLeft ? 'Left Pod' : 'Right Pod'} (Row ${rowIndex + 1})`,
      })
    })
  } else if (preset === 'triple_islands') {
    // Triple Islands: Left, Center, Right pods with 2 walking corridors
    const rowCount = Math.max(3, Math.ceil(N / 12))
    const thirdCount = Math.ceil(N / 3)
    const rowYStart = 28
    const rowYEnd = 88
    const rowYStep = (rowYEnd - rowYStart) / Math.max(1, rowCount - 1)

    studentNodes.forEach((node, idx) => {
      const podIndex = Math.min(2, Math.floor(idx / thirdCount))
      const localIdx = idx - podIndex * thirdCount
      const podTotal = podIndex === 2 ? N - 2 * thirdCount : thirdCount
      const colsPerPod = Math.ceil(podTotal / rowCount)

      const rowIndex = Math.min(rowCount - 1, Math.floor(localIdx / colsPerPod))
      const colIndex = localIdx % colsPerPod

      const xSpans = [
        { start: 8, end: 28, name: 'Left Pod' },
        { start: 40, end: 60, name: 'Center Pod' },
        { start: 72, end: 92, name: 'Right Pod' },
      ]
      const { start: xStart, end: xEnd, name: podName } = xSpans[podIndex]
      const xStep = colsPerPod > 1 ? (xEnd - xStart) / (colsPerPod - 1) : 0
      const posX = colsPerPod > 1 ? xStart + colIndex * xStep : (xStart + xEnd) / 2
      const posY = rowYStart + rowIndex * rowYStep

      results.push({
        id: node.id,
        label: node.label,
        pos_x: snapCoordinate(posX, snapGrid),
        pos_y: snapCoordinate(posY, snapGrid),
        row_label: `${podName} (Row ${rowIndex + 1})`,
      })
    })
  } else if (preset === 'u_perimeter') {
    // U-Shape Perimeter (Left wall, Back wall, Right wall)
    const leftCount = Math.floor(N * 0.35)
    const rightCount = Math.floor(N * 0.35)
    const backCount = N - leftCount - rightCount

    studentNodes.forEach((node, idx) => {
      let posX = 50
      let posY = 50
      let rowLabel = 'Perimeter'

      if (idx < leftCount) {
        const step = (86 - 28) / Math.max(1, leftCount - 1)
        posX = 12
        posY = 28 + idx * step
        rowLabel = 'West Wall'
      } else if (idx < leftCount + backCount) {
        const backIdx = idx - leftCount
        const step = (88 - 12) / Math.max(1, backCount + 1)
        posX = 12 + (backIdx + 1) * step
        posY = 88
        rowLabel = 'Rear Wall'
      } else {
        const rightIdx = idx - leftCount - backCount
        const step = (86 - 28) / Math.max(1, rightCount - 1)
        posX = 88
        posY = 86 - rightIdx * step
        rowLabel = 'East Wall'
      }

      results.push({
        id: node.id,
        label: node.label,
        pos_x: snapCoordinate(posX, snapGrid),
        pos_y: snapCoordinate(posY, snapGrid),
        row_label: rowLabel,
      })
    })
  }

  return results
}

  columns: number

  terminalNaming: 'alphanumeric' | 'sequential_pc' | 'side_prefix' | 'preserve'
  customRowNames?: Record<number, string>
  positions?: WorkstationPositionUpdate[]

  updated_at?: string

export interface CustomRoomGridSlot {
  slotIndex: number
  sideIndex: number // 0 to sides - 1
  rowIndex: number
  globalRowIndex: number
  colIndex: number
  rowLabel: string
  positionId: string // e.g. A1, A2, A3, A4, G1, G2, G3, G4...
  suggestedHardwareLabel: string // e.g. PC-01, PC-02...
  suggestedLabel: string // backwards compatibility or positionId
  pos_x: number
  pos_y: number
}

function getSideLayoutSpec(
  sideIndex: number,
  totalSides: number
): { xStart: number; xEnd: number; sideLabel: string; sidePrefix: string } {
  if (totalSides === 1) {
    return { xStart: 10, xEnd: 90, sideLabel: '', sidePrefix: '' }
  }
  if (totalSides === 2) {
    // 2 Sides (Left & Right Wings) optimized for spacious modular cubicles
    // Left Wing: 6% to 42% (12% step for 4 cols: 6%, 18%, 30%, 42%)
    // Central Walking Aisle: 42% to 58% (16% wide unobstructed corridor aligned with Teacher Podium at 50%)
    // Right Wing: 58% to 94% (12% step for 4 cols: 58%, 70%, 82%, 94%)
    if (sideIndex === 0) return { xStart: 6, xEnd: 42, sideLabel: ' (Left)', sidePrefix: 'L-' }
    return { xStart: 58, xEnd: 94, sideLabel: ' (Right)', sidePrefix: 'R-' }
  }
  if (totalSides === 3) {
    // 3 Sections (Triple Pods: Left, Center, Right) with two 12% wide walking aisles
    // Pod width = 20%, Aisles = 12% (10% even spacing between PCs)
    if (sideIndex === 0) return { xStart: 8, xEnd: 28, sideLabel: ' (Left)', sidePrefix: 'L-' }
    if (sideIndex === 1) return { xStart: 40, xEnd: 60, sideLabel: ' (Center)', sidePrefix: 'C-' }
    return { xStart: 72, xEnd: 92, sideLabel: ' (Right)', sidePrefix: 'R-' }
  }
  // totalSides === 4
  // 4 Island Pods (width 14% each) separated by 3 aisles (10% wide each)
  const spans = [
    { xStart: 7, xEnd: 21, sideLabel: ' (Pod 1)', sidePrefix: 'P1-' },
    { xStart: 31, xEnd: 45, sideLabel: ' (Pod 2)', sidePrefix: 'P2-' },
    { xStart: 55, xEnd: 69, sideLabel: ' (Pod 3)', sidePrefix: 'P3-' },
    { xStart: 79, xEnd: 93, sideLabel: ' (Pod 4)', sidePrefix: 'P4-' },
  ]
  return spans[sideIndex] || spans[0]
}

/**
 * Generates coordinate slots and systematic labels for a custom multi-row, multi-column, 1 to 4 sided room.
 * Each side has its own distinct set of rows (e.g. Left has Rows A..F with cols 1..4, Right has Rows G..L with cols 1..4).
 */
export function generateRoomGridSlots(
  config: CustomRoomGridConfig,
  snapGrid: number = 2
): CustomRoomGridSlot[] {
  const slots: CustomRoomGridSlot[] = []
  const { sides = 2, rows, columns, rowNaming, terminalNaming, customRowNames } = config

  const clampedSides = Math.max(1, Math.min(4, sides))
  const clampedRows = Math.max(1, Math.min(16, rows))
  const clampedCols = Math.max(1, Math.min(12, columns))

  const yStart = 28
  const yEnd = 88
  const yStep = clampedRows > 1 ? (yEnd - yStart) / (clampedRows - 1) : 0

  let sequentialPcIndex = 1

  // Traverse side by side so Left Pod is populated first (PC-01..PC-24, Rows A..F),
  // then Right Pod (PC-25..PC-48, Rows G..L)
  for (let s = 0; s < clampedSides; s++) {
    const { xStart, xEnd, sideLabel, sidePrefix } = getSideLayoutSpec(s, clampedSides)
    const xStep = clampedCols > 1 ? (xEnd - xStart) / (clampedCols - 1) : 0

    for (let r = 0; r < clampedRows; r++) {
      // Global row index across sections ensures each side has completely distinct row letters:
      // Side 0 (Left): r=0..5 -> globalRowIndex=0..5 -> 'A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'F'
      // Side 1 (Right): r=0..5 -> globalRowIndex=6..11 -> 'G', 'H', 'I', 'J', 'K', 'L'
      const globalRowIndex = s * clampedRows + r
      const defaultRowChar = String.fromCharCode(65 + (globalRowIndex % 26))
      const baseRowName =
        customRowNames?.[globalRowIndex]?.trim() ||
        (rowNaming === 'letters' ? `Row ${defaultRowChar}` : `Row ${globalRowIndex + 1}`)
      const rowChar = rowNaming === 'letters' ? defaultRowChar : `R${globalRowIndex + 1}`
      const posY = snapCoordinate(clampedRows > 1 ? yStart + r * yStep : 58, snapGrid)

      for (let c = 0; c < clampedCols; c++) {
        const posX = snapCoordinate(
          clampedCols > 1 ? xStart + c * xStep : (xStart + xEnd) / 2,
          snapGrid
        )

        // Terminal place / position ID: strictly 1 to columns (e.g. 1 to 4)!
        // Left side row 0: A1, A2, A3, A4
        // Right side row 0: G1, G2, G3, G4
        const positionId = `${rowChar}${c + 1}`
        const hardwarePcLabel = `PC-${String(sequentialPcIndex).padStart(2, '0')}`

        let displayLabel = ''
        if (terminalNaming === 'alphanumeric') {
          displayLabel = positionId
        } else if (terminalNaming === 'side_prefix') {
          displayLabel = `${sidePrefix}${rowChar}${c + 1}`
        } else if (terminalNaming === 'sequential_pc') {
          displayLabel = hardwarePcLabel
        } else {
          displayLabel = hardwarePcLabel
        }

        slots.push({
          slotIndex: slots.length,
          sideIndex: s,
          rowIndex: r,
          globalRowIndex,
          colIndex: c,
          rowLabel: `${baseRowName}${sideLabel}`,
          positionId,
          suggestedHardwareLabel: hardwarePcLabel,
          suggestedLabel: displayLabel,
          pos_x: posX,
          pos_y: posY,
        })
        sequentialPcIndex++
      }
    }
  }

  return slots
}

/**
 * Calculates workstation placement, positioning, and preserves physical hardware asset names.
 */
export function calculateCustomRoomLayout<
  T extends { id: string; label: string; row_label?: string | null; position_id?: string | null }
>(
  workstations: T[],
  config: CustomRoomGridConfig,
  snapGrid: number = 2,
  applySuggestedLabels: boolean = true
): WorkstationPositionUpdate[] {
  const { teacherNodes, studentNodes } = sortWorkstationsByLabel(workstations)
  const results: WorkstationPositionUpdate[] = []

  // 1. Teacher Podium(s)
  teacherNodes.forEach((node, idx) => {
    const posX = snapCoordinate(50 + (idx - (teacherNodes.length - 1) / 2) * 15, snapGrid)
    const posY = snapCoordinate(12, snapGrid)
    results.push({
      id: node.id,
      label: node.label.toLowerCase().includes('teacher') ? node.label : 'Teacher-01',
      position_id: 'PODIUM',
      pos_x: posX,
      pos_y: posY,
      row_label: 'Teacher Podium',
    })
  })

  // 2. If config.positions contains saved explicit coordinates, respect them directly
  if (config.positions && Array.isArray(config.positions) && config.positions.length > 0) {
    const posById = new Map(config.positions.map((p) => [p.id, p]))
    const posByLabel = new Map(config.positions.map((p) => [p.label, p]))

    studentNodes.forEach((node) => {
      const match = posById.get(node.id) || posByLabel.get(node.label)
      if (match) {
        results.push({
          id: node.id,
          label: match.label || node.label,
          position_id: match.position_id || node.position_id || null,
          pos_x: match.pos_x,
          pos_y: match.pos_y,
          row_label: match.row_label || node.row_label || null,
        })
      }
    })

    if (results.length === workstations.length) {
      return results
    }
  }

  // 3. Generate Grid Slots
  const slots = generateRoomGridSlots(config, snapGrid)

  // Map slots by slot index (1 to N) and positionId (e.g. A1, C2)
  const slotByNumber = new Map<number, (typeof slots)[0]>()
  const slotByPosId = new Map<string, (typeof slots)[0]>()
  slots.forEach((s) => {
    slotByNumber.set(s.slotIndex + 1, s)
    slotByPosId.set(s.positionId.toUpperCase(), s)
  })

  const occupiedSlotIndices = new Set<number>()
  const unassignedNodes: typeof studentNodes = []
  const extensionNodes: typeof studentNodes = []

  // 4. Match student nodes with PC numbers or position_id to slots (preserving gaps!)
  studentNodes.forEach((node) => {
    const numMatch = node.label.match(/\d+/)
    const pcNum = numMatch ? parseInt(numMatch[0], 10) : null

    // If terminal number exceeds configured room slots, treat as extension terminal
    if (pcNum && pcNum > slots.length) {
      extensionNodes.push(node)
      return
    }

    let matchedSlot: (typeof slots)[0] | undefined

    if (config.terminalNaming === 'preserve' || !applySuggestedLabels) {
      if (pcNum && slotByNumber.has(pcNum) && !occupiedSlotIndices.has(pcNum)) {
        matchedSlot = slotByNumber.get(pcNum)
      } else if (
        node.position_id &&
        slotByPosId.has(String(node.position_id).toUpperCase()) &&
        !occupiedSlotIndices.has(slotByPosId.get(String(node.position_id).toUpperCase())!.slotIndex + 1)
      ) {
        matchedSlot = slotByPosId.get(String(node.position_id).toUpperCase())
      }
    }

    if (matchedSlot) {
      occupiedSlotIndices.add(matchedSlot.slotIndex + 1)
      results.push({
        id: node.id,
        label: node.label,
        position_id: matchedSlot.positionId,
        pos_x: matchedSlot.pos_x,
        pos_y: matchedSlot.pos_y,
        row_label: matchedSlot.rowLabel,
      })
    } else {
      unassignedNodes.push(node)
    }
  })

  // 5. Assign unassigned nodes to remaining available slots
  const availableSlots = slots.filter((s) => !occupiedSlotIndices.has(s.slotIndex + 1))
  let availIdx = 0

  unassignedNodes.forEach((node) => {
    if (availIdx < availableSlots.length) {
      const slot = availableSlots[availIdx++]
      occupiedSlotIndices.add(slot.slotIndex + 1)
      let machineLabel = node.label
      const isCoordinateLabel = /^[A-Z]\d+$/i.test(node.label) || /^[LR]-\w+$/i.test(node.label)
      if (isCoordinateLabel || config.terminalNaming === 'sequential_pc') {
        machineLabel = slot.suggestedHardwareLabel
      } else if (applySuggestedLabels && !node.label.startsWith('PC-')) {
        machineLabel = slot.suggestedHardwareLabel
      }

      results.push({
        id: node.id,
        label: machineLabel,
        position_id: slot.positionId,
        pos_x: slot.pos_x,
        pos_y: slot.pos_y,
        row_label: slot.rowLabel,
      })
    } else {
      extensionNodes.push(node)
    }
  })

  // 6. Out-of-range or extension nodes placed into extension positions
  extensionNodes.forEach((node, extraIdx) => {
    const extCol = extraIdx % 4
    const extSide = Math.floor(extraIdx / 4) % 2
    const extRowIdx = Math.floor(extraIdx / 8)
    const xStart = extSide === 0 ? 6 : 58
    const xStep = 12
    const extX = snapCoordinate(xStart + extCol * xStep, snapGrid)
    const extY = snapCoordinate(100 + extRowIdx * 12, snapGrid)
    const rowName = `Row ${String.fromCharCode(77 + extRowIdx)} (Extension)`
    const posId = `EXT-${extraIdx + 1}`

    results.push({
      id: node.id,
      label: node.label,
      pos_x: extX,
      pos_y: extY,
      row_label: rowName,
      position_id: posId,
    })
  })

  return results
}

export interface LabDeskFloorStructure {
  sidesCount: number
  rows: LabDeskRowStructure[]
  wings: Array<{
    sideIndex: number
    title: string
    subtitle: string
    xStart: number
    xEnd: number
  }>
  centralAisle?: {
    xStart: number
    xEnd: number
    xCenter: number
  } | null
}

/**
 * Computes realistic architectural desk table surfaces and wing layouts for top-view rendering.
 */
export function getLabDeskFloorStructure(
  config?: CustomRoomGridConfig
): LabDeskFloorStructure {
  const sides = config?.sides || 2
  const rows = Math.max(1, Math.min(16, config?.rows || 6))
  const cols = Math.max(1, Math.min(12, config?.columns || 4))

  const yStart = 28
  const yEnd = 88
  const yStep = rows > 1 ? (yEnd - yStart) / (rows - 1) : 0

  const rowStructures: LabDeskRowStructure[] = []
  const wings: LabDeskFloorStructure['wings'] = []

  for (let s = 0; s < sides; s++) {
    const { xStart, xEnd } = getSideLayoutSpec(s, sides)
    // Add margin around workstations so desk looks like a real physical table surface
    const deskXStart = Math.max(2, xStart - 3.5)
    const deskXEnd = Math.min(98, xEnd + 3.5)
    const deskWidth = deskXEnd - deskXStart

    const sideName =
      sides === 2
        ? s === 0 ? 'Left Pod â€¢ Wing A' : 'Right Pod â€¢ Wing B'
        : sides === 3
        ? s === 0 ? 'Left Pod' : s === 1 ? 'Center Pod' : 'Right Pod'
        : sides === 4
        ? `Pod ${s + 1}`
        : 'Main Hall'

    const startLetter = String.fromCharCode(65 + ((s * rows) % 26))
    const endLetter = String.fromCharCode(65 + ((s * rows + rows - 1) % 26))

    wings.push({
      sideIndex: s,
      title: sideName.toUpperCase(),
      subtitle: `Rows ${startLetter}â€“${endLetter} (${rows * cols} PCs)`,
      xStart: deskXStart,
      xEnd: deskXEnd,
    })

    for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
      const globalRowIndex = s * rows + r
      const defaultRowChar = String.fromCharCode(65 + (globalRowIndex % 26))
      const rowName =
        config?.customRowNames?.[globalRowIndex]?.trim() ||
        (config?.rowNaming === 'numbers' ? `Row ${globalRowIndex + 1}` : `Row ${defaultRowChar}`)
      const posY = rows > 1 ? yStart + r * yStep : 58

      rowStructures.push({
        id: `desk_s${s}_r${r}`,
        sideIndex: s,
        rowIndex: r,
        globalRowIndex,
        rowName,
        sideName,
        xStart: deskXStart,
        xEnd: deskXEnd,
        y: posY,
        width: deskWidth,
      })
    }
  }

  const centralAisle =
    sides === 2
      ? {
          xStart: 45.5,
          xEnd: 54.5,
          xCenter: 50,
        }
      : null

  return {
    sidesCount: sides,
    rows: rowStructures,
    wings,
    centralAisle,
  }
}

import type { AuditStructuredDiff } from '../types/audit'

export const SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERNS = [
  'password',
  'new_password',
  'password_hash',
  'token',
  'secret',
  'smtp_password',
  'api_key',
  'otp',
  'access_token',
  'refresh_token',
]

export const MAX_DIFF_KEYS = 50
export const MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES = 50000

/**
 * Checks if a key name matches any known sensitive credential/secret keywords.
 */
export function isSensitiveKey(key: string): boolean {
  const lower = key.toLowerCase()
  return SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => lower.includes(pattern))
}

/**
 * Redacts sensitive fields recursively from a record object.
 */
export function redactSensitiveData(obj: Record<string, any> | null | undefined): Record<string, any> | null {
  if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object') return null
  if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
    return obj.map((item) => (typeof item === 'object' && item !== null ? redactSensitiveData(item) : item)) as any
  }

  const sanitized: Record<string, any> = {}
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    if (isSensitiveKey(key)) {
      sanitized[key] = '[REDACTED]'
    } else if (value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)) {
      sanitized[key] = redactSensitiveData(value)
    } else if (Array.isArray(value)) {
      sanitized[key] = value.map((item) =>
        typeof item === 'object' && item !== null ? redactSensitiveData(item) : item
      )
    } else {
      sanitized[key] = value
    }
  }
  return sanitized
}

/**
 * Recursively normalizes values (trims strings, converts numbers/booleans to string, converts Dates to ISO, handles null/undefined)
 */
export function normalizeValue(val: any): any {
  if (val === undefined || val === null) return null
  if (typeof val === 'number' || typeof val === 'boolean') return String(val)
  if (typeof val === 'string') return val.trim()
  if (val instanceof Date) return val.toISOString()
  if (Array.isArray(val)) return val.map(normalizeValue)
  if (typeof val === 'object') {
    const sorted: Record<string, any> = {}
    for (const k of Object.keys(val).sort()) {
      sorted[k] = normalizeValue(val[k])
    }
    return sorted
  }
  return val
}

/**
 * Computes a clean, redacted changed-keys diff between previous and next states.
 * Enforces a strict 50KB / 50-key truncation ceiling for bulk operations.
 */
export function computeStructuredDiff(
  before?: Record<string, any> | null,
  after?: Record<string, any> | null
): AuditStructuredDiff | null {
  if (!before && !after) return null

  if (before && after) {
    const allKeys = Array.from(new Set([...Object.keys(before), ...Object.keys(after)]))

    // Bulk operation safeguard: cap keys
    if (allKeys.length > MAX_DIFF_KEYS) {
      return {
        bulk_overflow: true,
        summary: `Bulk operation modified ${allKeys.length} properties, exceeding visual diff threshold.`,
        count: allKeys.length,
        before: { _keysCount: allKeys.length },
        after: { _keysCount: allKeys.length },
      }
    }

    const changedBefore: Record<string, any> = {}
    const changedAfter: Record<string, any> = {}

    for (const key of allKeys) {
      const bRaw = before[key]
      const aRaw = after[key]

      const bVal = bRaw !== undefined ? bRaw : null
      const aVal = aRaw !== undefined ? aRaw : null

      const bNorm = normalizeValue(bVal)
      const aNorm = normalizeValue(aVal)

      if (JSON.stringify(bNorm) !== JSON.stringify(aNorm)) {
        if (isSensitiveKey(key)) {
          changedBefore[key] = bVal !== null ? '[REDACTED]' : null
          changedAfter[key] = aVal !== null ? '[REDACTED]' : null
        } else {
          changedBefore[key] = typeof bVal === 'object' && bVal !== null ? redactSensitiveData(bVal) : bVal
          changedAfter[key] = typeof aVal === 'object' && aVal !== null ? redactSensitiveData(aVal) : aVal
        }
      }
    }

    // ðŸ›¡ï¸ Safeguard: If caller passed both before and after for an update, but values normalized identically,
    // ensure the update is NOT silently dropped. Record the provided update fields as a delta.
    if (Object.keys(changedBefore).length === 0) {
      console.warn('[AUDIT ENGINE] No delta found between before and after:', {
        before,
        after,
      })
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(after)) {
        if (k !== 'updated_at' && k !== 'created_at') {
          changedBefore[k] = before[k] !== undefined ? (isSensitiveKey(k) ? '[REDACTED]' : before[k]) : null
          changedAfter[k] = isSensitiveKey(k) ? '[REDACTED]' : v
        }
      }
    }

    // Check payload serialization size
    const jsonStr = JSON.stringify({ before: changedBefore, after: changedAfter })
    if (jsonStr.length > MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES) {
      return {
        bulk_overflow: true,
        summary: `Diff payload size (${Math.round(jsonStr.length / 1024)}KB) exceeded 50KB limit.`,
        count: Object.keys(changedBefore).length,
      }
    }

    return { before: changedBefore, after: changedAfter }
  }

  // Pure creation, deletion, or single-state update fallback
  const cleanBefore = redactSensitiveData(before)
  const cleanAfter = redactSensitiveData(after)
  const single = cleanBefore ? { before: cleanBefore } : cleanAfter ? { after: cleanAfter } : null
  if (!single) return null
  const jsonStr = JSON.stringify(single)

  if (jsonStr.length > MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES) {
    return {
      bulk_overflow: true,
      summary: `Payload size (${Math.round(jsonStr.length / 1024)}KB) exceeded 50KB limit.`,
      count: cleanBefore ? Object.keys(cleanBefore).length : cleanAfter ? Object.keys(cleanAfter).length : 0,
    }
  }

  return single
}
